title.rendered: Claude can now control your Mac, but what can you actually do with it?

content.rendered:
Claude can now use your Mac the way you do. It can open apps, move through websites, edit files, and complete tasks on its own instead of just giving instructions.

Anthropic is rolling this out as a research preview through Claude Cowork and Claude Code. It is limited to macOS and requires a paid plan, either Claude Pro or Max.

It’s not completely new tech. However, most agents are currently limited to browsers or specific connected apps. Claude Cowork, on the other hand, can now take over the entire desktop, with access to all apps and files, powered by its proven agent orchestration.

Claude can move across apps and do the work for you

Claude Cowork and Claude Code can already do a few tasks on your computer, like organizing and editing files, but they do this using terminal commands. Because of that, the scope of what they can do is limited.

Now, with this new feature, Claude can see your screen, click UI elements, fill out forms, and navigate the Mac interface like we do.

For example, I can ask it to open Chrome, go to a site, log in, pull information, then switch to a local document and update it. It can jump between apps and websites to get things done.

Here are a few things you can try asking Claude now

You can ask almost any task that can be done through your computer. For example,

  • You can ask it to open a spreadsheet, copy rows, paste them into a website, and repeat that process.
  • Or check Slack, pick out updates, and summarize them.
  • You can even ask it to collect information from different places and turn it into a simple report.
  • It can even check your LinkedIn profile to learn about your details and apply for suitable jobs by filling in your information automatically.
  • Or, you can ask it to buy stuff, compare products based on reviews and features, or even install specific apps.

However, the better approach is to find boring and repetitive tasks that you have to do manually and ask it to handle them.

You can now enable Claude to use your computer to complete tasks.

It opens your apps, navigates your browser, fills in spreadsheets—anything you'd do sitting at your desk.

Research preview in Claude Cowork and Claude Code, macOS only. pic.twitter.com/sVymgmtEMI

— Claude (@claudeai) March 23, 2026

It also supports ongoing tasks. I can tell it to scan my email every morning or prepare a report every Friday, and it keeps doing that. I can assign something from my phone and come back later to a Mac where the work is already done.

However, the process is slow to feel like magic. For normal tasks, it’s better to complete them yourself and move on, but for repeated tasks, you can let it run, take its time, and come back to completed work. That’s where it is actually useful in its current state.

It is early, and the limits are obvious

This is still a research preview, and it shows.

First, it is limited to macOS, and you need a subscription to get started. Also, it sometimes asks for permission for simple actions like opening websites, but may skip asking for tasks that actually need it, such as deleting documents, submitting applications, or sending Slack messages.

Anthropic is also clear about avoiding sensitive data for now, which makes sense because this is essentially giving an AI access to your desktop.

In its current state, I would not trust it with anything critical. But for repeatable, low-risk tasks, it is already useful.

title.rendered: MacBook Neo vs Mac mini: Which one should you actually buy?

content.rendered:
With the launch of MacBook Neo, Apple’s Mac lineup feels more diverse than ever. At the budget end, buyers now face a clear choice. The MacBook Neo is built for those who want portability and an all-in-one laptop experience, while the Mac mini caters to users looking for a compact yet powerful workstation.

At first glance, both sit in a similar price range, which can make the decision feel tricky. But once you look at how these machines fit into everyday use, the difference becomes clearer. If your day involves moving around with your laptop, the MacBook Neo fits in naturally. If your work happens at a desk and demands more from your system, the Mac mini starts to make more sense.

In this comparison, I’ll break down where each Mac stands in real-world use, so you can figure out which one actually fits your workflow.

Table of Contents
  • MacBook Neo vs Mac mini: Quick Comparison
  • Design and Portability: What Actually Changes in Daily Use
  • Performance and Real-World Usage: Where the Difference Shows
  • RAM and Storage: What Matters Over Time
  • Ports and Connectivity: Setup vs Simplicity
  • Battery vs Desk Setup: A Lifestyle Decision
  • Who Should Buy MacBook Neo?
  • Who Should Buy Mac mini?
  • My Take After Comparing Both

MacBook Neo vs Mac mini: Quick Comparison

Design and Portability: What Actually Changes in Daily Use

The MacBook Neo, like any other MacBook, is all about convenience. It is lightweight, compact, and comes with everything built in, including a display, keyboard, and trackpad. You can pick it up and start working anywhere without needing additional accessories.

The Mac mini takes a more traditional desktop approach. It is small enough to fit into any setup, but it still depends on external peripherals. This makes it less flexible in movement, but far more adaptable as part of a workstation.

If your work involves moving around, the MacBook Neo naturally fits better. A fixed desk setup leans heavily in favor of the Mac mini.

Performance and Real-World Usage: Where the Difference Shows

The performance difference between the two devices makes the comparison much clearer.

For everyday use, the MacBook Neo holds up well. Browsing, writing, streaming, and light editing all feel smooth. For most people, this is exactly the kind of performance they need on a daily basis. However, its limitations become apparent under heavier workloads, where the fixed 8GB of RAM and mobile-class chip can become a bottleneck.

Things start to change once your workload grows. If you are someone who keeps multiple heavy apps open or works on larger projects, the Mac mini feels far more capable. It comes with 16GB of RAM as standard and can be configured up to 32GB, and if you need even more power, there is also an M4 Pro variant. From video editing to development and heavy multitasking, it delivers a level of power that the MacBook Neo simply cannot match.

RAM and Storage: What Matters Over Time

One of the biggest practical differences lies in how these machines scale over time.

As stated above, the MacBook Neo is limited to 8GB of RAM with no option to upgrade. While this works for basic usage today, it can become restrictive as workloads grow.

The Mac mini offers significantly more flexibility, with configurations going up to 32GB RAM for the M4 Mac mini and large storage options. This makes it a more future-proof option for users planning to keep their system for several years or run heavier applications.

Storage is where the gap becomes even more noticeable. While the MacBook Neo tops out at 512GB of storage, the M4 Mac mini can be configured all the way up to 2TB. That kind of capacity makes a real difference if you work with large files, maintain extensive media libraries, or prefer storing projects locally rather than relying on external drives or cloud storage.

In terms of long-term usability, the Mac mini has a clear advantage.

Ports and Connectivity: Setup vs Simplicity

The difference in ports reflects how both machines are meant to be used, but connectivity goes beyond just cables.

On the Mac mini, you get a wider range of ports, including Thunderbolt, HDMI, and Ethernet, which makes it easier to plug everything in and leave it connected. It suits a setup where multiple devices stay attached and ready to go.

The MacBook Neo keeps things minimal with just a couple of USB-C ports, which fits its portable nature. For most users, wireless connectivity does the heavy lifting here. With Wi-Fi and Bluetooth handling accessories like headphones, keyboards, and mice, you rarely need to plug in multiple devices at once.

As your setup grows, the difference becomes more noticeable. The Mac mini adapts more easily to a wired environment, while the MacBook Neo leans heavily on wireless convenience.

Battery vs Desk Setup: A Lifestyle Decision

One runs on battery while the other does not. That difference changes how you use it every day.

With the MacBook Neo, you can open the lid and get to work anywhere without thinking about power. The built-in battery makes it easy to move between rooms, work on the go, or sit through long sessions without being plugged in. If you need something that moves with you, works anywhere, and stays simple, the MacBook Neo fits naturally into that role.

The Mac mini is tied to a desk. It needs constant power and a full setup around it, but in return, you get a more stable environment with no concerns about battery life interrupting your workflow. If your work is desk-based and demands more from your machine, the Mac mini makes more sense. It gives you more power, more flexibility, and a setup that can grow with your needs.

Who Should Buy MacBook Neo?

The MacBook Neo makes sense if your usage is straightforward and you value portability.

It is a great fit for students, casual users, and anyone who wants a reliable Mac for everyday tasks without overthinking the setup.

Who Should Buy Mac mini?

The Mac mini is better suited for users who expect more from their machine. If your work involves heavier apps, larger files, or longer sessions at a desk, it offers the kind of consistency and flexibility that holds up over time.

My Take After Comparing Both

The MacBook Neo and Mac mini are not competing products in the traditional sense. They represent two different ways of approaching the same price point.

One focuses on simplicity, portability, and accessibility, making it a great everyday machine. In contrast, the other focuses on performance and flexibility, making it a better fit for more demanding and long-term use.

The right choice depends on how you actually use your Mac day to day.

Which one are you leaning towards, MacBook Neo or Mac mini? Drop your pick in the comments and tell me why.

title.rendered: WWDC 2026 confirmed: Dates, keynote time, and what to expect

content.rendered:
Apple has officially confirmed that its 37th Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC 2026) will take place from June 8 to June 12, 2026. The keynote is scheduled for June 8 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, where Apple is expected to unveil iOS 27, macOS 27, and its next generation of software updates.

I’ve followed WWDC closely over the years, and if you’re waiting for major Apple updates, this is the one event that sets the tone for everything coming later in the year. Like recent editions, WWDC 2026 will be primarily online and free to watch, with a limited in-person experience at Apple Park.

WWDC 2026 Dates and Keynote Details

  • Event dates: June 8 to June 12, 2026
  • Keynote: June 8 at 10:00 a.m. PT
  • Format: Free, online-first event

As always, the event kicks off with Apple’s keynote on the opening day. This year, it is scheduled for June 8 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time.

From my experience, the keynote is where Apple reveals the headline features, but the real depth comes later in the week through developer sessions and labs. These sessions often give a clearer picture of how the updates will actually impact everyday use.

What Apple Is Expected to Announce

Apple is expected to introduce its next lineup of software platforms, including:

  • iOS 27
  • iPadOS 27
  • macOS 27
  • watchOS 27
  • tvOS 27
  • visionOS 27

While the spotlight usually stays on iOS, I’ve noticed that the most meaningful changes often come from smaller system-level improvements. Things like better cross-device integration, performance upgrades, and AI-driven features tend to shape the real user experience over time.

If you use an iPhone, iOS 27 will likely define how your device feels for the next year, even if some of the biggest changes aren’t obvious on day one.

Apple Park In-Person Event: Who Can Attend

Alongside the online event, Apple will host a special in-person experience at Apple Park in Cupertino on June 8.

Selected attendees will be able to:

  • Watch the keynote and State of the Union live
  • Interact with Apple engineers
  • Explore the Apple Park campus

However, attendance is limited and based on a lottery system.

Eligible applicants include:

  • Apple Developer Program members
  • Apple Developer Enterprise Program members
  • Apple Entrepreneur Camp alumni
  • Swift Student Challenge winners

Applications are open until March 30, and selections will be announced shortly after.

From what I’ve seen in previous years, the biggest advantage of attending in person isn’t just watching the keynote. It’s the direct access to Apple engineers and deeper technical conversations you simply don’t get from the livestream.

Swift Student Challenge and Developer Sessions

Apple has already completed submissions for its Swift Student Challenge earlier this year. Winners will be announced soon, and distinguished winners will receive invitations to Cupertino for a multi-day experience.

For everyone else, WWDC 2026 will include a full lineup of online sessions and labs.

These sessions focus on:

  • New APIs and frameworks
  • Developer tools and updates
  • Hands-on implementation guidance

In my experience, these labs are where developers get the most value. They go beyond announcements and actually show how to use the new features in real projects.

How to Watch WWDC 2026

You can watch the WWDC 2026 keynote and sessions through:

  • Apple Developer app
  • Apple’s official website
  • Apple’s YouTube channel

Personally, I prefer watching it on YouTube since it’s easier to rewind during announcements and revisit key moments without switching platforms.

What I’ll Be Watching Closely

Every WWDC has a few standout themes, and this year, I’ll be paying attention to:

  • How Apple expands AI features across iOS 27
  • Any major design changes or UI shifts
  • Improvements in ecosystem integration between devices

From past events, I’ve learned that the biggest updates aren’t always the ones Apple highlights on stage. Some of the most impactful changes reveal themselves only after using the software for a few weeks.

Looking Ahead to WWDC 2026

WWDC 2026 continues Apple’s hybrid approach, balancing global accessibility with an exclusive in-person experience.

While the keynote will grab the most attention, the real story usually unfolds in the weeks that follow, when these updates start shaping how people actually use their devices.

If Apple follows its recent trajectory, iOS 27 and the broader ecosystem updates could end up being more impactful than they first appear.

What are your expectations from WWDC 2026? Share your thoughts in the comments.

title.rendered: I Thought My WhatsApp Was Secure Until I Checked These Settings

content.rendered:
If you think your WhatsApp is “secure by default,” you’re only half right. Yes, end-to-end encryption protects your messages in transit. However, in 2026, hackers don’t need to break encryption; they just need to trick you. From sneaky scams to hidden settings you’ve probably ignored, your account could be more exposed than you realize.

The good news? You don’t need to be a cybersecurity expert to protect yourself. Here’s my complete setup to protect my WhatsApp account from hackers and unauthorized access. I have shown the privacy settings for both iOS and Android versions so you can follow along.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Turn On Two-Step Verification First (This Matters Most)
  • 2. Never Share This WhatsApp Code. Seriously
  • 3. Check Your Linked Devices. I Found This Risk
  • 4. Lock Your WhatsApp with Face ID or Chat Lock
    • Enable App Lock
    • Lock Individual Chats
  • 5. Turn On Security Alerts Most People Ignore
  • 6. Secure Your WhatsApp Backup Before It’s Too Late
  • 7. Stop Random People from Adding You to Groups
  • 8. Change These Privacy Settings to Stay Hidden
  • 9. Secure Your SIM Card to Prevent Account Takeover
  • 10. Block and Report Suspicious Messages Instantly
  • 11. Keep WhatsApp and Your Phone Updated
  • 12. Turn Off Auto-Download to Avoid Hidden Malware
  • 13. Use Disappearing Messages for Sensitive Chats
  • What to Do If Your Account Is Hacked
  • After These Changes, My WhatsApp Feels Much Safer

1. Turn On Two-Step Verification First (This Matters Most)

If there’s one feature that instantly makes your WhatsApp more secure, it’s two-step verification. Without it, anyone who obtains access to your SIM card or verification SMS can log in to your account in seconds. However, two-factor authentication adds another layer. Until the right PIN is entered, no one can access your WhatsApp on their device.

  1. Open WhatsApp and tap the You profile tab to go to settings.
  2. Tap Account from the settings list and select Two-step verification.
  3. Tap Turn on.
  4. Create a strong 6-digit PIN and enter it again for confirmation.
  5. Select Add email and type your email address for recovery. Tap Next.
  6. Now WhatsApp will send a code to that email address. Follow the onscreen instructions.

This is a quick process that will only take a minute of your time, and it will save you from losing your entire account.

Quick expert tips:

  • Do not use obvious PINs like 123456 or your birth year.
  • Do not store your PIN in your notes app without proper protection.
  • If you forget your PIN, you will be locked out of your entire account for days or even lose it forever. Always link a recovery email.

2. Never Share This WhatsApp Code. Seriously

Your WhatsApp verification code (OTP) is your master key. If someone else has access to your WhatsApp verification code and your PIN, they can use your account.

Here’s how the scam usually works:

You receive a message or call from someone pretending to be a friend, support agent, or even a company. They say something like: “I accidentally sent a code to your number—can you share it?” That “code” is actually your WhatsApp login OTP. The moment you share it, your account is gone.

Therefore, never share your verification code with anyone—under any circumstances.

What you should do instead:

  • Ignore the message completely
  • Block and report the sender
  • Never type or forward the code to anyone

Even if the message looks like it’s from someone you know, always verify it first by calling or using another app. Also, remember: WhatsApp will never ask for your verification code via chat, call, or email. If someone does, it’s a scam!

3. Check Your Linked Devices. I Found This Risk

WhatsApp’s multi-device feature lets you use your account on a laptop, tablet, or browser. But here’s the catch: if someone else links their device to your account, they can read your messages without you even knowing. That’s why regularly checking your linked devices is a must for WhatsApp account protection.

  1. Go to Settings in WhatsApp by tapping your profile photo.
  2. Tap Linked Devices.
  3. Review the list of active sessions. Tap the one you don’t recognize.
  4. Scroll down, tap Log Out, and confirm.

Also, avoid logging in on public or shared systems in the future and always log out of all devices you don’t actively use.

4. Lock Your WhatsApp with Face ID or Chat Lock

Even if your WhatsApp account is secure online, what happens if someone gets physical access to your phone? That’s where biometric locks come in. They add a powerful layer of protection by requiring your fingerprint or Face ID to open WhatsApp or specific chats.

Enable App Lock

First, lock the app to secure all the chats and hide message previews from notifications.

On iPhone:

  1. Tap and hold the WhatsApp app.
  2. Select Require Face ID from the dropdown.
  3. Finally, tap Require Face ID and authenticate your identity.

On Android:

  1. Launch the Settings app.
  2. Tap Security and privacy > App Lock.
  3. Authenticate your fingerprint or Face ID.
  4. Now, toggle on WhatsApp.

Lock Individual Chats

WhatsApp offers a built-in Chat Lock feature.

  1. Open a chat.
  2. Tap the contact name at the top.
  3. Toggle on Lock chat and tap Continue.
  4. Authenticate your biometrics.

5. Turn On Security Alerts Most People Ignore

WhatsApp uses end-to-end encryption to keep your messages private, but what if something changes behind the scenes? That’s exactly what security notifications are designed to alert you about.

When enabled, WhatsApp will notify you whenever a contact’s security code changes. This usually happens when they reinstall WhatsApp or switch devices. But in rare cases, it could signal something suspicious.

To turn it on:

  1. Go to your WhatsApp’s You profile and select Account.
  2. Tap Security notifications.
  3. Toggle on Show security notifications on this phone.

Now, if someone re-installs WhatsApp or changes their phone, you’ll be notified.

6. Secure Your WhatsApp Backup Before It’s Too Late

Even though your WhatsApp chats are encrypted, your chat backup is not. That means your entire chat history, photos, and documents could be exposed through cloud storage if not properly secured.

To enable end-to-end encrypted chat backups:

  1. Open your WhatsApp Settings by tapping the You tab.
  2. Tap Chats > Chat backup.
  3. Now tap End-to-end encryption, then select More options > Create password.
  4. Set a strong password and tap Next. Retype the password and hit Next.
  5. Tap Create.
Important If you forget your backup password or lose the encryption key, you won’t be able to recover your backup, and WhatsApp can’t even help.

7. Stop Random People from Adding You to Groups

Getting added to random WhatsApp groups isn’t just annoying; it can also expose you to spam, scams, and malicious links. In many cases, attackers use group chats to target multiple users at once.

The good news? WhatsApp gives you full control over who can add you to groups. You just need to turn on the setting.

  1. Go to the You Tab.
  2. Tap Privacy and select Groups.
  3. Choose one of these options:
    • Everyone
    • My Contacts
    • My Contacts except…

Now, if someone can’t add you, they’ll have to send you a private invite. You can accept or ignore it.

8. Change These Privacy Settings to Stay Hidden

Most people leave WhatsApp’s privacy settings on default, and that’s exactly what scammers rely on. By tweaking a few options, you can control who sees your personal information and reduce your chances of being targeted.

  1. Open WhatsApp settings and access Privacy.
  2. From here, you can set key options like Last Seen & online, Profile picture, About, and Links to My Contacts.
  3. Toggle off Read receipts.
Bonus

In the Privacy Settings, scroll down and select Privacy Checkup. Here, you can review all the important settings to protect your personal information.

9. Secure Your SIM Card to Prevent Account Takeover

Your WhatsApp account is tied directly to your phone number, which means that if someone takes control of your SIM, they can access your WhatsApp, too. So, you must secure them to protect you Whatsapp account from hackers.

In this type of attack, someone tricks your mobile carrier into transferring your number to a new SIM card. Once they have it, they can use your verification codes to log in to your account.

To secure your SIM and number:

  • Set a SIM PIN on your phone. On iPhone, go to Settings > Cellular > SIM PIN, toggle it on, and set a PIN. Similarly, lock your SIM on Android.
  • Contact your carrier and enable SIM lock / port-out protection.
  • Avoid sharing your phone number publicly on social media and never tell OTPs ot personal details over calls.

10. Block and Report Suspicious Messages Instantly

Suspicious messages are not only frustrating but also the starting point for a scam or phishing attack. So, WhatsApp allows you to block and report suspicious accounts in an instant.

  1. Open the suspicious chat. Don’t reply or click links. 
  2. Under the contact name, select Block.
  3. On iPhone, select Block and report. For Android, checkmark Report to WhatsApp.

Now, WhatsApp reviews five recent messages and can take action, like banning the account. This helps prevent others from becoming victims.

11. Keep WhatsApp and Your Phone Updated

If you ignore updates, you’re leaving the door open for attackers. Most security breaches don’t happen because apps are weak, but because users are running outdated versions with known vulnerabilities. So, avoid using outdated or unsupported devices.

  1. Open App Store on iPhone or Google Play Store on Android.
  2. Search for WhatsApp and check for any updates. Tap Update to install the new version.
  3. Next, navigate to Settings on your device.
  4. On iPhone, select General > Software Update. For Android, go to System & update > Software update.
  5. Download and install any new OS version. Restart your phone after major updates for the best performance.

12. Turn Off Auto-Download to Avoid Hidden Malware

Auto-downloading media might feel convenient, but it can quietly expose your phone to malicious files, scams, and unnecessary data clutter. Attackers often disguise malware or phishing links in PDFs, APK files, or images, hoping it gets downloaded without you even noticing.

By turning off auto-download, you take back control over what enters your device.

  1. Navigate to your WhatsApp’s You profile tab.
  2. Tap Storage and Data.
  3. Under Media Auto-Download, set Never for Photos, Audio, Video, and Documents.

Now, manually download files only from trusted contacts. Also, avoid opening unknown documents or compressed files.

13. Use Disappearing Messages for Sensitive Chats

When you share sensitive photos or confidential info on WhatsApp, use this feature to reduce the risk of your data being stored or misused.

Enable disappearing messages:

  1. Open a chat.
  2. Tap the contact’s name.
  3. Select Disappearing Messages.
  4. Choose a duration (24 hours, 7 days, or 90 days).

Send view-once media:

  1. In a chat, tap the plus icon next to the text box and select Photos,
  2. Now, choose an image or video.
  3. Tap the “1” icon before sending.
  4. Now, when the recipient opens the media, it will disappear.

What to Do If Your Account Is Hacked

If your WhatsApp gets hacked, don’t panic! Act immediately. The faster you respond, the higher your chances of recovering your account and limiting damage.

  1. Try logging back in immediately. Use your phone number and request a new verification code.
  2. Confirm the hack: Check if you got OTPs you didn’t initiate, messages sent without your knowledge, or unknown devices linked to your account.
  3. Email WhatsApp support: Report the issue as soon as possible. 
  4. Notify your contacts: Tell them to ignore any strange messages from your account. 
  5. Secure your SIM and email: Check if your number or email has been compromised. Also, scan your phone for malware.

After recovering your WhatsApp account, review all your security settings and apply all the protection tips in this guide. Hackers often try again!

After These Changes, My WhatsApp Feels Much Safer

WhatsApp is secure, but only if you use it securely. Most attacks today rely on human mistakes, not technical flaws. That means small actions, like enabling two-step verification or being cautious with messages, can make a huge difference. 

If you apply even half of these tips, you’ll already be ahead of most users and far less likely to become a target. Also, if you found this helpful, consider sharing it with friends and family.

title.rendered: These Mac Games Are Actually Worth Playing (2026)

content.rendered:
For the longest time, gaming on a Mac felt like a compromise. Limited titles, inconsistent performance, and the constant need for workarounds made it hard to take it seriously. That is no longer the case.

Thanks to Apple Silicon, gaming on Mac has finally taken a meaningful turn. Developers are paying attention, AAA titles are arriving natively, and performance has improved across the board. But here is the reality. Not every game that runs on macOS is worth your time.

So instead of listing everything that “works” on macOS, I spent time testing the games that actually matter.

These are the games that stand out.

Table of Contents
  • Best Mac Games to Play in 2026
    • 1. Cyberpunk 2077
    • 2. Resident Evil 4 (Remake)
    • 3. Assassin’s Creed Shadows
    • 4. Death Stranding: Director’s Cut
    • 5. Control
    • 6. Hollow Knight Silksong
    • 7. Blue Prince
  • What You Should Know Before Playing Games on a Mac
  • Mac Gaming in 2026: What It’s Actually Like

Best Mac Games to Play in 2026

Mac gaming in 2026 looks very different from what it used to be. With AAA games now having native macOS versions, you are not limited to a handful of casual or poorly optimized titles.

What stood out during my testing is how quickly the gap between Mac and traditional gaming platforms is closing, but only for a select group of games. After using both a MacBook Pro and a PlayStation 5 extensively, it is clear that the best Mac gaming experiences come from titles built for Apple Silicon or properly optimized for Metal. Anything outside that still feels like a compromise.

Right now, the Mac gaming landscape is shaped by three types of games:

  • AAA titles that push hardware limits: These are visually demanding games that show what modern Macs can handle when optimization is done right.
  • Well-optimized mid-tier games: Games that balance performance and visuals, offering a consistently smooth experience without requiring top-end hardware.
  • Indie titles with strong gameplay focus: These don’t rely on heavy graphics but deliver some of the most engaging and polished experiences available on macOS.

The key difference in 2026 is choice. You are no longer asking, ‘Can I play games on a Mac?’ Instead, you are deciding.

1. Cyberpunk 2077

Cyberpunk 2077 builds a world that gradually pulls you in, with every mission and interaction adding to that sense of immersion.

You play as V, a mercenary navigating Night City while sharing your mind with a digital construct of Johnny Silverhand. The core loop revolves around exploration, story missions, and character progression, but what makes it stand out is how naturally everything connects.

The moment it clicked for me was during a late-night drive through Night City. Rain hitting the windshield, neon reflections everywhere, and a random side quest popping up that turned into a full storyline I did not plan for. That sense of continuity makes the world feel alive rather than scripted.

Gameplay-wise, you’re given a lot of freedom. You can approach situations as a stealth hacker, a guns-blazing mercenary, or something in between. Hacking systems mid-combat, slowing time, or manipulating enemies creates a flexible combat system that rarely feels repetitive.

Performance-wise, I had to tweak settings initially. Once dialed in, it became surprisingly stable, but you can feel when your hardware is being pushed.

This is the only game here where I lost track of time completely.

Download

2. Resident Evil 4 (Remake)

This is easily the most polished experience I tested.

You play as Leon Kennedy on a mission to rescue the president’s daughter, but the story quickly escalates into something far more intense. The strength here lies in pacing. The narrative unfolds alongside gameplay, never interrupting it, but always pushing it forward.

The village fight early in the game set the tone. I remember running low on ammo, trying to manage space, and constantly repositioning. It felt intense without being frustrating.

Every system in the game serves a purpose. Movement is responsive, shooting feels precise, and enemy encounters are carefully structured to maintain tension without overwhelming you. The balance between action and horror is handled exceptionally well.

From a performance perspective, this is one of the best-optimized games on Mac. Frame stability is strong, load times are quick, and overall responsiveness is consistent even on mid-tier machines.

This is the most reliable experience on this list. It is polished, consistent, and easy to recommend.

Download

3. Assassin’s Creed Shadows

At its core, Assassin’s Creed Shadows tells a dual-perspective story set in feudal Japan, blending personal conflict with political tension.

The two protagonists aren’t just gameplay variations; they represent different worldviews. One operates from the shadows, driven by precision and secrecy, while the other embraces direct confrontation and honor. Their stories intersect in ways that add emotional depth to the broader narrative.

The setting plays a major role in storytelling. The game explores themes of loyalty, identity, and power during a time of shifting political structures. It is not just about missions. It is about understanding the world you’re operating in.

One mission in particular stood out. Instead of rushing in, I spent time observing patrol routes, waiting for the right moment, and using the environment to stay hidden. It felt more satisfying than direct combat.

On Mac, performance is stable on newer Apple Silicon devices, though it benefits from higher-end configurations for consistent frame rates.

This is a game you play slowly. It’s less about constant action and more about immersion and methodical progression.

Download

4. Death Stranding: Director’s Cut

Death Stranding delivers one of the most distinctive narratives in modern gaming.

You play as Sam Porter Bridges, tasked with reconnecting a fractured society in a post-apocalyptic world. The story explores themes of isolation, connection, and human dependency in a way that feels unusually reflective for a game.

I remember trying to cross a rocky area while carrying too much cargo. As I lost balance, adjusted weight, and rerouted, it turned into a small challenge on its own.

What stayed with me was the silence. Long stretches where nothing happens, and then suddenly, tension builds. The music kicking in during certain moments genuinely changes how the journey feels.

Performance-wise, this is one of the best-optimized AAA titles available. It runs smoothly on Apple Silicon, with stable performance and impressive visuals even on mid to high-end configurations.

This is not a game for quick sessions. It’s slow, intentional, and almost meditative. If you’re willing to invest time, it delivers something genuinely different from anything else on this list.

Download

5. Control

Control leans heavily into mystery-driven storytelling. You step into the role of Jesse Faden, searching for answers about her past while navigating a secretive government agency dealing with supernatural events. The story is intentionally fragmented. You piece it together through documents, recordings, and environmental clues.

The core gameplay revolves around telekinetic abilities. You’re not just shooting enemies, you’re interacting with the environment in real time. Pulling objects from the surroundings and launching them mid-combat creates a dynamic flow that feels different in every encounter.

Combat evolves as you progress. New abilities unlock different approaches, allowing you to combine movement, powers, and weapons fluidly.

It took a little time before the combat started to feel natural, but once I unlocked more abilities, things opened up. I remember one fight where I was lifting objects, throwing them at enemies, and moving through the air at the same time. After that, the gameplay started to feel more fluid.

It’s not a game I played in long sessions, but every session felt distinct.

This is for players who want something mechanically engaging rather than just visually impressive.

Download

6. Hollow Knight Silksong

Silksong takes a subtler approach to environmental storytelling. There is very little direct exposition. Instead, the world, characters, and interactions gradually reveal the narrative. You learn by exploring, observing, and connecting the dots yourself.

What makes it compelling is the level design. Areas are interconnected in a way that encourages exploration without feeling overwhelming. Discovering shortcuts, hidden paths, and new abilities keeps progression satisfying.

Combat is fast and demanding. Boss fights require pattern recognition and quick reactions. Every mistake feels fair, which makes improvement feel rewarding rather than frustrating. I remember struggling with a boss fight for a while. Repeating the same pattern, failing, adjusting, and eventually getting it right. That sense of improvement is what makes it addictive.

There is no hand-holding here. You explore, get lost, figure things out, and slowly build confidence.

Performance is flawless on Mac. Even older systems handle it without any issues, making it one of the most accessible games here.

This is pure gameplay. No distractions, just skill, patience, and progression.

Download

7. Blue Prince

Blue Prince focuses on emergent storytelling through gameplay rather than a fixed narrative.

There is no traditional storyline driving the experience. Instead, the narrative forms through your decisions, the rooms you choose, and the paths you take. Each run feels like a different version of the same story.

At its core, it is a puzzle roguelike where each run presents a different layout. You’re constantly choosing which rooms to enter, which paths to take, and how to approach the challenges inside.

The interesting part is how small decisions compound. A choice that seems insignificant early on can completely alter your options later. This creates a strong sense of consequence and replayability.

I went in without expectations and ended up spending more time thinking than playing. Every decision felt like it mattered more than I initially assumed.

There were runs where I realized too late that an earlier choice limited my options later. That kind of delayed consequence made me rethink how I approached each attempt.

On Mac, it runs effortlessly. Performance is not a concern here, which allows you to focus entirely on the gameplay.

This is the most mentally engaging game on the list. Ideal when you want something thoughtful rather than intense.

Download

What You Should Know Before Playing Games on a Mac

Before you go ahead and install any of the games on this list and are ready to jump in, keep these practical points in mind:

  • AAA games require at least 16GB of RAM for stable performance
  • M1 Macs can run many games, but M2 or newer gives a noticeably better experience
  • Indie games are far more forgiving and run smoothly on almost any setup

Choosing the right game based on your Mac matters just as much as the game itself.

Mac Gaming in 2026: What It’s Actually Like

These are my picks for the best Mac games in 2026. After playing them across both a MacBook Pro and a PlayStation 5, one thing became clear. Mac gaming has moved beyond simply finding titles that run.

It now comes down to choosing the kind of experience you want.

Each game on this list earned its place because it delivers a complete experience, with solid performance, engaging gameplay, and enough depth to keep you invested.

Which game caught your attention the most? I’d love to hear what you’re playing on your Mac.

  • Best MMORPGs for Mac

title.rendered: What It Actually Takes to Get Verified on Roblox: Here’s How to Get It

content.rendered:
Getting that blue checkmark on Roblox feels impossible, and in many ways, it is. It is not designed for most users, and Roblox doesn’t even provide an option to apply for verification. Accounts are automatically reviewed and verified when they meet certain criteria.

While the process is automatic, strict, and built around scale, there is still a clear path that can help you qualify for the verification badge, often without you actively aiming for it.

Here is exactly how the system works and what it really takes to get there.

Types of Roblox Verification: ID vs Verified Badge

On Roblox, there are two types of verification:

  • ID verification for all users
  • Verified badge for notable creators

ID verification involves submitting a government ID and taking a selfie. Roblox uses this to confirm your identity and age, which unlocks voice chat, 17+ experiences, and more relaxed communication features. This is mainly about access, and you can check this article to learn more about how to apply and get voice chat.

The verified badge is completely different. This is something that reflects your presence on the platform, and Roblox adds a badge next to your username in the app.

Can You Apply for Roblox Verification?

This is the biggest misconception. There is no form to fill out, no request button, and no direct way to ask for verification.

Instead, the system is passive. Roblox tracks accounts that meet its criteria and reviews them in cycles, usually once a month. Even if you qualify today, nothing happens immediately. Your account gets picked up in a later review.

The process works like this:

  • You meet the criteria
  • Roblox reviews your account
  • The badge appears later without notice

You do not apply. You qualify.

Roblox Verification Requirements: What You Need to Qualify

Roblox evaluates accounts using three signals. Think of this as a filter. You need to pass all three to move forward.

1. Notability Requirements (Followers, Playtime, Revenue)

This is the hardest part and also the most important consideration for Roblox to verify you. Roblox is looking for accounts that are already large and recognized.

Typical thresholds look like this:

  • Developers need over 1 million hours of playtime in the last 90 days
  • UGC creators need around 2 million Robux in revenue and 200,000 sales in the same period
  • Influencers or brands usually need around 100,000 followers on a major platform or involvement in official Roblox programs

At this stage, effort is not the deciding factor. Scale is. Your work needs to reach enough people that Roblox can confidently label it as notable.

2. ID Verification and Eligibility Rules

Once you reach that scale, Roblox needs to confirm that the account actually belongs to you.

This is done through ID verification. You submit a government-issued document and complete a face scan. The system checks if your identity matches the account owner.

This is not similar to the ID verification for all users to verify the user’s age. You can get verified even if you are under 17. However, users under 13 are not eligible for the verified badge.

3. Security and Activity Requirements

Verified accounts are high-value targets, so Roblox expects strong security and consistent usage. You need to:

  • Enable two-factor authentication using an authenticator app
  • Keep the account active consistently
  • Stay active on the platform

This tells Roblox that your account is secure, maintained, and not abandoned.

Must read: Tips to protect your Roblox account from hackers

How Roblox Gives the Verified Badge (No Application Needed)

Once all requirements are met, there is no final step or confirmation. Roblox reviews eligible accounts during its monthly cycles. If your account passes all checks, the badge is added automatically.

There is no notification or approval message. The badge simply appears.

This badge is a trust signal for people to find your account easily and avoid impersonators. However, it doesn’t provide any in-game advantages or improve how your game or UGC items are recommended on the platform.

If you’re building your own experience, learning how to make a Game Pass on Roblox can help you monetize your game and grow faster.

Can You Lose the Roblox Verified Badge?

The system does not stop after you get verified. Even small changes can result in losing the badge:

  • Changing your username or display name
  • Disabling two-factor authentication
  • Violating platform rules
  • Long inactivity

If this happens, your account may need to be reviewed again in a future cycle.

Why Most People Never Get Verified on Roblox

Most people try to chase verification directly, but that approach does not work. Verification is not something you aim for on its own. It is the result of reaching a certain level of scale, trust, and consistency. A better approach is to focus on what leads to it:

  • Build experiences that people actually spend time in
  • Grow a real audience, not inflated numbers
  • Stay consistent over time

When your work reaches that level, verification becomes a byproduct.

title.rendered: Apple’s Entry-Level iPad With A18 Chip And Apple Intelligence Still Set For 2026 Launch

content.rendered:
Apple is preparing to launch a new entry-level iPad with an A18 chip and support for Apple Intelligence, with the device still on track to arrive in 2026. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman said the product is “ready to go” and remains scheduled for release this year, positioning it as the final iPad model to gain Apple’s AI features.

A18 Chip Enables Apple Intelligence On Entry-Level iPad

The upcoming model is expected to move from the A16 chip in the current iPad to the A18, enabling support for Apple Intelligence. That shift is significant because the base iPad is currently the only model in Apple’s lineup without access to the company’s on-device and cloud-assisted AI features.

The A18 chip, already used in the iPhone 16 lineup, is designed to handle Apple Intelligence tasks such as text generation, summarization, and system-wide assistance. Bringing that capability to the lowest-cost iPad expands Apple’s AI platform across its entire tablet range.

Launch Window And Scope Of Changes

The device has been on Apple’s internal roadmap for a release aligned with the iOS 26.4 cycle, which runs through the first half of 2026. With that software update nearing completion, the hardware is expected to debut within the same timeframe. Gurman indicated the product is ready for launch, suggesting that timing now depends on Apple’s release schedule rather than development readiness.

No major design or hardware changes have been reported for the new model. The iPad is expected to retain the same overall design as the current generation, with the A18 upgrade serving as the primary update. There are indications that Apple could introduce its in-house connectivity components, including a C1 modem and N1 networking chip, though those details remain unconfirmed.

Apple last updated the base iPad in March 2025 with the A16 chip, starting at $349 in the United States. With the addition of Apple Intelligence, the next model would bring feature parity with the iPad mini, iPad Air, and iPad Pro, completing Apple’s transition to AI-capable hardware across its tablet lineup.

excerpt.rendered: Apple’s upcoming base iPad with an A18 chip is expected to launch in 2026, adding Apple Intelligence and completing the company’s AI rollout across its iPad lineup.

title.rendered: Apple WWDC 2026: Event Date, iOS 27 Changes, and What to Expect

content.rendered:
Apple’s biggest software event of the year is getting closer, and the conversation around WWDC 2026 has already started to take shape. The company hasn’t shared official dates yet, but all signs point to its usual early June window, with the keynote expected to land in the second week of the month.

What is more interesting than the timing, though, is the shift in focus.

This year’s updates, led by iOS 27, are not expected to chase dramatic redesigns or headline-grabbing features. Instead, Apple appears to be entering a phase where refinement, intelligence, and long-term platform stability take priority.

WWDC 2026 Timeline

Apple has consistently scheduled WWDC in the first half of June, and this year is expected to follow the same pattern. Based on this trend, the event could run from June 8 through June 12, with the keynote taking place on the opening day.

Apple typically confirms the dates toward the end of March, so an official announcement should arrive soon.

WWDC 2026: What to Expect

iOS 27 Could Be More About Polish Than New Features

This year’s iOS update does not appear to be about bold visual changes. Instead, iOS 27 is expected to focus on improving performance, reducing bugs, and delivering a more stable experience overall.

Apple has taken this approach before with polish updates that refine the system after multiple feature-heavy releases. The aim here is to make everyday interactions faster and more reliable without changing the core experience.

AI Could Take Center Stage Once Again

Artificial intelligence is likely to remain a major theme at WWDC 2026. Reports suggest that Siri could become more context-aware, backed by deeper integration with Apple Intelligence features.

Rather than introducing flashy additions, Apple is expected to focus on making AI more useful in real-world scenarios, while continuing its emphasis on on-device processing for privacy.

No Major Redesign Expected, but Improvements Are Likely

The existing Liquid Glass design language is expected to stay in place. Apple may instead refine elements such as readability, contrast, and overall interface consistency.

This signals a shift toward polishing the current design rather than introducing a completely new visual direction.

Hints of Foldable iPhone Support

iOS 27 could also include early groundwork for future hardware (iPhone Fold). Some reports point to early internal support for foldable displays, suggesting Apple is preparing its software for new form factors that could arrive later in 2026.

Try: Download the WWDC 2026 wallpapers in 4k

A Subtle but Strategic Update

Alongside iOS 27, Apple is expected to unveil updates across macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS, continuing its ecosystem-wide evolution.

WWDC 2026 may not be about dramatic announcements. Instead, it appears to be a transition phase focused on stability, intelligence, and long-term improvements.

What would you like Apple to improve in iOS 27? Drop your thoughts below.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to Switch from Business to Personal Account on Instagram

content.rendered:
With influencer culture and brand marketing on the rise on Instagram, many users are switching to a Business account for insights, ads, and professional tools. These features help track performance and promote content, but they are not useful for everyone. However, not every business or aspiring influencer finds success, and many users eventually prefer a simpler, more private experience.

This is why many users look for ways to turn off their business account. The problem is that Instagram does not offer a direct option to disable a Business account. Instead, you need to switch the account back to a Personal account.

This post explains how to switch your Instagram business account to a personal account and what happens after.

Table of Contents
  • What is an Instagram Business Account?
  • 2 Ways to Switch Back to Personal Account on Instagram
    • Via the Professional Dashboard
    • From the Account Settings
  • What Happens After Switching to a Personal Account on Instagram
  • Why People Turn Off Business Accounts on Instagram
  • Can You Switch Back to a Business Account Later?
  • Difference Between a Business and Personal Account on Instagram
  • Back to a Simpler Instagram Experience…

What is an Instagram Business Account?

As the name suggests, a Business Account on Instagram is an account type designed for brands, companies, and service providers. It unlocks various tools and insights useful for growth and marketing that aren’t available to personal accounts and are largely similar to those in creator accounts.

Key features include:

  • Insights for posts and followers
  • Ad and promotion tools
  • Contact buttons, such as email or call
  • Access to Meta business tools
  • Product tagging and shopping features

2 Ways to Switch Back to Personal Account on Instagram

There are two ways you can turn off the business account on Instagram. Here’s how:

Via the Professional Dashboard

  1. Tap the Professional Dashboard banner on your Instagram profile.
  2. Tap the Settings icon in the top right corner.
  3. Next, scroll down and tap Switch account type.
  4. Now, choose “Switch to personal account.”
  5. Tap Switch to confirm.

You must read: 7 Key Instagram privacy settings you should change

From the Account Settings

  1. Head to your Instagram profile and tap the hamburger (More options) icon in the top right corner.
  2. Here, scroll down and tap Account type and tools under the For professionals section.
  3. Next, tap Account type.
  4. Now, tap Switch account type, then choose “Switch to personal account.”
  5. Tap Switch to confirm.

What Happens After Switching to a Personal Account on Instagram

Switching your account type does not affect your existing content or followers. However, you lose access to features and tools such as:

  • Insights and analytics data
  • Ad and promotion tools
  • Contact buttons on your profile
  • Access to a professional dashboard

Your account simply returns to a regular Instagram experience.

What Stays the Same:

  • Your posts, reels, and stories remain unchanged
  • Your followers and following list stay intact
  • Direct messages and chats are not affected

Why People Turn Off Business Accounts on Instagram

There are a few common reasons users switch back to a Personal account:

  • Simpler experience: Business tools add extra sections and notifications that are not always needed.
  • More control over privacy: Personal accounts can be set to private, giving you full control over who sees your content.
  • No need for analytics: If you are not tracking growth or running campaigns, insights may not be useful.

Can You Switch Back to a Business Account Later?

Just as you switched from a business account to a personal account, you can switch back to a business account at any time if you decide to use Business features again.

Difference Between a Business and Personal Account on Instagram

Each of the three Instagram account types is designed for a different kind of user and comes with its own tools and limitations. Understanding the differences can help you choose the account type that fits your needs.

Back to a Simpler Instagram Experience…

And that’s it; now you know that turning off a Business account on Instagram simply means switching it back to a Personal account. The process takes only a few taps and does not affect your posts, followers, or messages.

If you no longer need analytics or promotional tools and want to make your account private, this is the only way to simplify your Instagram experience while keeping everything else intact.

Have you switched your Instagram account back to Personal, or are you still using Business features? Share your experience in the comments.

You may like to read:

  • How to use AI Voice Effects in Instagram DMs
  • How to Block and Unblock Someone on Instagram
  • Instagram Restrict vs. Block: Which should you choose?

title.rendered: I Tested These Coloring Apps and Ditched Paper (Best Picks for iPhone and Android)

content.rendered:
Coloring isn’t just for kids anymore! It’s a fun, relaxing way for anyone to unwind, get creative, improve focus, and take a break from screens filled with stress. Whether you’re looking for a calming activity after a long day or a playful app to keep kids engaged, coloring apps make it easy to dive into creativity anytime, anywhere.

In this guide, I’ve rounded up the best coloring apps for iPhone, iPad, and Android that offer beautiful designs, intuitive tools, and something for every age group. And you don’t require any artistic skill; just open them and start filling in colors.

Table of Contents
  • How I Picked the Best Coloring Apps in 2026 (What Actually Matters)
  • I Tested These Coloring Apps So You Don't Have To
    • 1. Happy Color By Numbers Game: Offers a relaxing, no-effort coloring experience
    • 2. Sandbox Pixel Art: Unique game-like coloring
    • 3. Color Pop AI – Coloring Book: Enjoy creative flexibility with smart tools
    • 4. Coloring Book for Me: Calming, artistic experience
    • 5. Jelly Dye: Satisfying ASMR Game: Funny 3D graphics
    • 6. Color Page ASMR – Art Coloring: Guided coloring experience
  • Which Coloring App Should You Actually Use? (My Honest Picks)
  • Final Thoughts: What These Coloring Apps Taught Me After Using Them

How I Picked the Best Coloring Apps in 2026 (What Actually Matters)

Not all coloring apps feel the same. Some are designed to help you relax, while others lean more toward quick, game-like satisfaction. After trying a bunch of them, I’ve found that the “best” app really depends on how you plan to use it.

Before you download anything, here are a few things that actually matter:

  • Ease of Use: If you just want to relax, go for apps with tap-to-fill or paint-by-number systems. They’re simple and don’t require any learning curve.
  • Content Library: Some apps get boring pretty fast. If the app is good, then they’ll add more content frequently. So, you always have something fresh to color.
  • Ads and Pricing: Most free apps come with ads or locked content. If that bothers you, check if there’s a one-time purchase or a reasonable subscription.
  • Offline Support: Not every app works without internet. If you travel or have limited data, this makes a big difference.
  • AI Features: Some newer apps can suggest colors, auto-fill sections, or even turn your photos into coloring pages. It’s not essential, but it’s a nice bonus.

I Tested These Coloring Apps So You Don’t Have To

I have tested a mix of popular and lesser-known coloring apps to find the ones that are actually fun to use, not just stuffed with ads or repetitive designs. The apps below strike a good balance between ease of use, variety, and overall experience.

One more thing: my list below focuses on coloring apps, not full-fledged drawing tools like Sketchbook or Ibis Paint X. If you want to create art from scratch, those are better options. But if you just want something easy, relaxing, and fun, a dedicated coloring app is the way to go

1. Happy Color By Numbers Game: Offers a relaxing, no-effort coloring experience

I keep coming back to Happy Color whenever I just want to relax without thinking too much. It is a paint-by-numbers kind of app, and all you have to do is just tap away. There’s no guesswork, and it’s surprisingly satisfying once you get into it.

You get over 40,000 high-quality pictures from nature, atmospheric themes, and exclusive Disney scenes from The Lion King, Cinderella, Winnie the Pooh, etc., plus original hand-drawn pictures from artists worldwide.

The app also adds new images daily, which keeps things fresh. You can also color postcards, add a personal note, and share them with your loved ones. The best part is you get to enjoy all these for free, and coloring doesn’t require the internet.

Pros

  • Extremely easy to use 
  • Huge collection of images 
  • Daily new artwork 
  • Great for beginners 

Cons

  • Limited creative freedom (mostly guided coloring) 
  • Ads in the free version 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Sandbox Pixel Art: Unique game-like coloring

If you enjoy pixel-style designs, Sandbox Pixel Art is one of the most satisfying apps you can use.

You zoom into a grid and fill tiny squares with colors one by one—similar to retro game graphics. It feels a bit like solving a puzzle, especially with more detailed images. Along with the pictures offered in the app, you can turn your photos from the gallery into pixel art.

Additionally, the app includes a free drawing mode to help you practice pixel art.

Pros

  • Unique pixel-art style 
  • Great zooming and precision controls 
  • Fun and addictive 

Cons

  • Can feel repetitive over time 
  • Less artistic variety compared to others 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Color Pop AI – Coloring Book: Enjoy creative flexibility with smart tools

Color Pop AI feels more modern compared to most coloring apps. Instead of just filling sections, it lets you highlight parts of an image while keeping the rest black and white. You can even use AI to generate coloring pages using prompts or turn photos into different types of sketches, which you can color later.

After you finish your artwork, you can share it with others in the Color Pop community. What I liked about this app is its intuitive, realistic painting tools. Select a palette, choose the brushes and effects, and start coloring!

Pros

  • AI-powered features 
  • More creative control than basic apps 
  • Clean and modern interface 
  • Extensive catalogues including Mandala, patterns, and florals

Cons

  • Some features are locked behind a subscription 
  • Slight learning curve 

Price: Free (Weekly Premium Pass starts at $7.99) 

Download: iPhone | Android

4. Coloring Book for Me: Calming, artistic experience

This is the app I open when I want something calm and distraction-free. This app is designed primarily for adults who enjoy detailed artwork, such as mandalas and patterns, which are great for slowing down and focusing. You get unique gradients, textures, and a more artistic feel compared to basic color-by-number apps. 

Simply, create your own mandala and color it with different palettes while listening to soothing music. You can also color sketches using your own pictures. The app also provides coloring games if you want a fast-paced session.

Pros

  • Beautiful, detailed designs 
  • Advanced coloring tools 
  • Relaxing background music
  • Great for mindfulness 

Cons

  • Premium required for full access 
  • Not ideal for quick casual use 

Price: Free (Premium weekly starts at $2.99)

Download: iPhone | Android 

5. Jelly Dye: Satisfying ASMR Game: Funny 3D graphics 

Jelly Dye is more of a satisfying ASMR-style coloring game than a traditional coloring app. You inject colors in a soft, jelly-like animation that feels oddly relaxing. Just handpick the right color and pinpoint the best injection position to match the model above. I really liked its 3D graphics for the wobbly jelly reflections.

Pros

  • Highly satisfying visuals 
  • Simple and fun 
  • No-skill gameplay
  • Great for stress relief and quick breaks

Cons

  • Limited artistic depth 
  • Repetitive gameplay 

Price: Free (Premium Membership starts at $4.99)

Download: iPhone | Android 

6. Color Page ASMR – Art Coloring: Guided coloring experience

If you want something super simple, especially for your kids, Color Page ASMR is easy to get into. It guides you through drawing and coloring step by step, which makes it feel more interactive than most apps. As you go through the levels, you get more complex pictures.

Pros

  • Unique tracing + coloring combo 
  • Very beginner-friendly 
  • Relaxing gameplay 

Cons

  • Not ideal for advanced users
  • Lack of creative freedom

Price: Free (Remove ads for $1.99)

Download: iPhone | Android

Which Coloring App Should You Actually Use? (My Honest Picks)

Choosing the right app depends on your goal: 

  • Just want to relax? Go with Happy Color. 
  • Love pixel-style games? Try Sandbox Pixel Art.
  • Want AI and creativity? Pick Color Pop AI. 
  • Looking for detailed art? Choose Coloring Book for Me. 
  • Want something satisfying and fun? Try Jelly Dye or Color Page ASMR. 

If you’re unsure, start with Happy Color; it’s the easiest entry point. 

Final Thoughts: What These Coloring Apps Taught Me After Using Them

After spending time with these apps, one thing is clear. Coloring apps in 2026 are less about “art” and more about how you want to feel while using them.

Some are built to help you slow down and relax. Others are designed to keep you engaged with quick, satisfying interactions. The best ones manage to do both without overwhelming you with features or ads.

If you’re just getting started, don’t overthink it. Pick one app that looks simple and appealing, try it for a few minutes, and see how it fits into your routine. You can always switch later.

At the end of the day, the right coloring app is the one you actually enjoy opening, whether that’s for a quick break, a creative moment, or just a way to unwind after a long day.

Don’t miss out on these posts as well:

  • Best Keyboard Apps for iPhone and Android
  • Best Wallpaper Apps for iPhone and Android
  • Best Coupon Apps for iPhone and Android to Save Money

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best Weather Apps for iPhone and Android You Can Use Right Now

content.rendered:
Weather apps are no longer just about checking the temperature before stepping out. They’ve become a part of how we plan our daily lives. Before heading out, planning a trip, or even deciding on weekend plans, most of us check the weather first. We look at forecasts to understand what conditions will be like at our destination, and then plan accordingly.

This growing reliance makes choosing the right weather app more important than ever. But with hundreds of options available, finding one that truly fits your needs is not as simple as it sounds.

To save you the effort, I’ve done the heavy lifting and narrowed it down to the five best weather apps for iPhone and Android you can rely on right now.

Why a Good Weather App Matters

Not all weather apps deliver the same level of accuracy or detail, and that difference can directly impact how useful they are in real situations.

A good weather app focuses on precision and timing. Features like minute-by-minute rain forecasts, real-time radar, and location-specific alerts can help you avoid getting caught in sudden weather changes. This becomes important during travel, outdoor activities, or daily commutes.

Another key factor is how information is presented. The best apps make complex data easy to understand, so you can quickly decide what to do without digging through unnecessary details.

In contrast, a poorly optimized app may show delayed updates, generic forecasts, or cluttered data, which reduces its reliability.

In short, the right weather app is informative, actionable, and gives you clarity at the exact moment you need it.

5 Best Weather Apps for iOS and Android Users

These are the weather apps I found most reliable for accurate forecasts and real-time updates.

1. The Weather Channel

The Weather Channel goes beyond basic forecasting and positions itself as a complete weather platform. It combines accurate forecasts with live radar, storm tracking, and regular updates on ongoing weather conditions.

Its interface is designed to be easy to understand, even with a lot of information on screen. Along with hourly and 10-day forecasts, it also includes videos and insights that help you understand what’s happening rather than just showing numbers.

Pros

  • Comprehensive forecasts and radar
  • Strong severe weather alerts
  • Easy to understand

Cons

  • Heavy ads
  • Feels content-heavy
  • Data usage concerns

Download: iPhone | Android

2. AccuWeather

AccuWeather is one of the most widely used weather apps, known for its reliable forecasts and precise short-term predictions. Its MinuteCast feature stands out by showing minute-by-minute rain updates, which are genuinely useful when you are about to step out.

The app presents detailed information like temperature, humidity, wind speed, and air quality in a structured format. Radar maps and severe weather alerts add another layer of usefulness, making it a strong choice for everyday planning.

Pros

  • Strong short-term accuracy with MinuteCast
  • Detailed weather data and alerts
  • Reliable for daily planning

Cons

  • Ads in free version
  • Key features behind subscription
  • Interface feels slightly crowded

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Windy.com

Windy is designed for users who want a detailed and visual understanding of weather conditions. Instead of focusing on simple forecasts, it presents interactive weather maps that show wind patterns, rainfall, pressure, and more.

The app also allows switching between different forecast models, giving a broader perspective on upcoming conditions. This makes it more suitable for advanced users than casual ones.

Pros

  • Advanced maps and weather models
  • Highly detailed data
  • Great for professionals

Cons

  • Steep learning curve
  • Overkill for casual use
  • Interface can feel complex

Download: iPhone | Android

4. CARROT Weather

CARROT Weather takes a different approach by blending accurate forecasts with a highly customizable interface. It allows you to choose how weather data is presented and even switch between different data sources.

The app is known for its personality-driven experience, but beyond that, it delivers solid forecasting and excellent widget support. It feels more tailored compared to most other weather apps.

Pros

  • Highly customizable
  • Multiple data sources
  • Excellent widgets

Cons

  • Subscription required for full features
  • Not ideal for basic users
  • Setup takes time

Download: iPhone | Android

5. MyRadar

MyRadar is a fast, radar-focused weather app that emphasizes real-time weather tracking. Instead of relying only on forecasts, it shows animated radar maps so you can see exactly what’s approaching your location.

The app opens directly into a live radar view, making it easy to check conditions at a glance. It also includes rain alerts and layers for wind, temperature, and cloud cover, which adds more context without complicating the experience.

Pros

  • Excellent real-time radar
  • Fast and easy to use
  • Reliable rain alerts 

Cons

  • Limited long-term forecast detail
  • More focused on visuals than data
  • Some features require a subscription

Download: iPhone | Android

How to Choose the Right Weather App

Choosing the right weather app comes down to how you plan to use it. Not every app is built for the same purpose, so the best option depends on your priorities.

  • Accuracy: Look for apps known for reliable and timely forecasts, not just good design.
  • Check short-term vs long-term forecasts: Some apps are better for minute-by-minute updates, while others focus on daily or weekly predictions.
  • Look for real-time updates: Frequent refresh rates and live data make a noticeable difference in daily use.
  • Radar and maps: A good radar view helps you track rain, storms, and movement in real time.
  • Level of detail: Choose based on your needs, basic info for casual use or detailed metrics like wind, AQI, and UV index for deeper insights.
  • Ease of use: The app should present information clearly without requiring too much navigation.
  • Alerts and notifications: Timely warnings for rain or severe weather can be genuinely useful.
  • Customization and widgets: Useful for quick access and a more personalized experience.
  • Ads and pricing: Free apps often include ads, while premium versions unlock better features.

Making the Right Choice

There is no single weather app that works for everyone. Each app excels in a specific area. Some focus on accuracy, others on visualization, and a few on customization. The best approach is to choose one that matches how you actually use weather data. For most people, a combination of a simple forecast app and a radar-based app works best.

Do you have a favorite weather app that didn’t make this list? Share it in the comments.

@graph.name: AccuWeather
@graph.description: AccuWeather provides a comprehensive and complete weather report of your location, and it’s also one of the best weather apps for the Apple Watch. I recommend this if you’re looking to get rainfall or snow forecasts up to 120 minutes before stepping out. Getting the exact temperature and rainfall likelihood in your area is one of the features you’ll find helpful on this app, as it updates you in real-time as the day passes. AccuWeather forecasts weather accurately by connecting to various meteorological APIs and mining weather data around you. This helps the app provide actionable insights about impending weather changes. Its MinuteCast feature allows you to foresee precipitation chances and temperature changes for a specified future time. It also has a weather alert system, but this is only currently available for US users. The free version features ads, which aren’t overly intrusive. But watch out! You might click an ad without knowing it’s an ad. However, you can opt for the premium plan to cancel ads and get advanced features.

properties.name: AccuWeather
properties.description: AccuWeather provides a comprehensive and complete weather report of your location, and it’s also one of the best weather apps for the Apple Watch. I recommend this if you’re looking to get rainfall or snow forecasts up to 120 minutes before stepping out. Getting the exact temperature and rainfall likelihood in your area is one of the features you’ll find helpful on this app, as it updates you in real-time as the day passes. AccuWeather forecasts weather accurately by connecting to various meteorological APIs and mining weather data around you. This helps the app provide actionable insights about impending weather changes. Its MinuteCast feature allows you to foresee precipitation chances and temperature changes for a specified future time. It also has a weather alert system, but this is only currently available for US users. The free version features ads, which aren’t overly intrusive. But watch out! You might click an ad without knowing it’s an ad. However, you can opt for the premium plan to cancel ads and get advanced features.

properties.name: Yahoo Weather app for the iPhone
properties.description: Yahoo Weather offers great value for a free app. The app gives an hourly temperature forecast within 24 hours and a 15-minute interval precipitation forecast within an hour. So users stay in the loop as weather changes in real-time. You can also keep track of temperature changes for the next seven days from your current period. You might get shocked seeing extreme temperature values, but no worries, Yahoo Weather presents these numbers in Fahrenheit instead of Celcius. There’s a thunderstorm forecast, displayed with the percentage likelihood of precipitation, all on the dashboard. The dashboard also details humidity percentage, visibility, ultraviolet index, air quality index, and wind current. What’s unique about Yahoo Weather is it shows the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases in your region. The COVID-19 stat would’ve been better if you could check incidence for specific locations around you. The only reservation I have for this one is that its location auto-detection algorithm can use better precision.
