Expired Anime Final Quest Codes

100MILLIONVISITS, ADMIRAL, AFKISFIXED, AFQISCLEAN, AGRIS2, AIZEN, APOLOGIZE, APOLOGIZEFORTHEDELAY, ATOMICISBACK, ATTACKTITAN, ATTACKTITANEVOLUTION, BATTLEPASS, BIGBUGFIXUPDATE, BLACKMARKET, BOSS, BOWUPDATE, BUGFIX, BUGFIXEDUPDATE, BUGFIXUPDATE07, CHAINSAW, CHILDOFSUN, CHUMIMIM, CLANS, COSMICUPDATE, CRACKER, CYBORGEVO, DELAYAPOLOGY, DELAYAPOLOGYEVOLVE, DELAYCODEREDONE, DELAYFORGOKUBLACK, DEVELOPERSHAND, DIORAID, EIDMUBARAK, ENDLESS, ENDLESSNEW, ESCANORSOON, EVOLUTION3, EVOLUTIONSOON, FEAREDSLAYER, FIXESDONE, FLAMINGO, FRIDAYSPECIAL, GAMEMODEUPDATEDELAY, GEAR5, GENERALEVO, GIFTFROMCELLGAMES, GIFTSGIFTS, GOKUBLACK, GRAVITATION, GREATERQUEST, GRINDTIME, GRINDTIME5, GUTSANDDELAY, HAKIGEA, HAKIGEAR, HAPPYNEWYEAR, HOLLOWGEAR, HOLLOWPURPLEGEAR, HYPETHERELEASE, KING, KINGOFCURSESISBACK, KINGRIPPEREVO, KINGSVESSEL, LAWYER, LEGEND, LEVELBUGFIX, MARINEFORD, MERRYCHRISTMAS, METRODOMAIN, MOVEMENT, NEWAFKITEMYAY, NEWGAMEMODE, NEWRAIDINAFQ, NEWSEASON, NEWTRAITFEATURE, NEWTRAITRARITY, NEWULTIMATESKILL, NEWXPREWARDS, NEXTUPDATEISCRAZY, NEZHADELAYAPOLOGY, OLDWEAPONSGRINDFIX, ORAORAORA!, PATCHES, PATCHISTOMORROW, PERFECTION, PITYFIXED, PREPAREFORTHERAID, PRIESTEVO, PROMISEDCODE, QOL, QOLINAFQ, QUEENOFCURSES, QUESTANDTOWERFIX, RAID, RAIDBOSSMONSTER, RAIDUPDATE, RELEASEAFQ, RESTORE, ROBLOXSTOPBULLYING, SABERUPDATE, SANDVILLAGE, SHADOW, SIDEUPDATE, SOMEFREERUNES, SOMETHINGCOSMICISNEAR, SONKING, SORRYFORBUGSGEAR5, SORRYFORDELAY2, SORRYFORDELAYANDBUG, SORRYFORTHEBUG, SOULREAPER, SOULREAPEREVOLUTION, SPIDER, STARTOFANEWERA, STRAWHAT, STRAWHATREWORK, SUPPORT, SWORDSAINT, TAILED BEAST, TEMPEST, TESTINGPLACEISBACK, THANKSFOR200KMEMBERS, THANKSFOR25KCCU, THEFORGERISNICE, THEYNOTLIKEUS, THUNDERGOD, TICKETGIFT, TOWERPROTECTION, TUSKQUEST, UNLUCKY, UPDATE1, UPDDELAYEDTOTOMORROW, UPGRADESYSTEM45, USEYOURLUCK, VAMPIREINAFQ, VERGIL, VERGILSOON, VL, WEEKENDEVENT, WEEKENDGIFT, WEEKENDGIFT2, WELCOMEBACKVN, WELOVEAFQ, WELOVEITEMS, WINTERUPDATE, WORLD2END

How to Redeem Anime Final Quest Codes

Redeeming codes takes less than a minute. Before starting, make sure you have joined the official Anime Final Quest Roblox group, as some codes require group membership.

Follow these steps:

  1. Open Roblox and launch Anime Final Quest.
  2. On the right side of the screen, click the blue Codes (ticket) icon.
  3. Enter or paste an active code into the text box.
  4. Click Confirm to redeem your rewards.

If the code is valid, rewards are added instantly. If not, the game will display an error message.

Where to Find Anime Final Quest Codes

To stay updated, rely on official and trusted sources. New codes are usually shared first through the following channels:

  • Official Discord server – Dedicated code-list channel and announcements
  • Roblox game page and group – Update posts and event notices
  • Developer social media – Twitter (X) and Instagram occasionally share codes

You can also bookmark this page. We update this page as soon as new codes drop from the developers.

Tips for Using Anime Final Quest Codes Effectively

Redeeming codes correctly is only half the benefit. Using rewards at the right time makes a real difference.

  • Redeem codes immediately to avoid expiration
  • Always copy and paste codes to prevent spelling errors or extra spaces
  • Keep a simple checklist of active and redeemed codes
  • Save spins for major updates or new gear additions
  • Use cash and runes before major upgrade milestones
  • Redeem raid tickets when preparing for coordinated boss runs

Aligning code rewards with your current progression goals ensures maximum value from every redemption.

Final Thoughts on Anime Final Quest Codes

Anime Final Quest codes are one of the most efficient ways to progress faster while avoiding excessive grinding. They provide consistent access to cash, spins, runes, and raid tickets that directly support character growth and combat readiness.

By following official sources, redeeming codes early, and using rewards strategically, you can stay ahead of difficulty spikes with minimal effort. Check for new codes regularly and redeem them as soon as they appear.

FAQs

How often are new Anime Final Quest codes released?

New codes are released frequently, especially during updates, events, milestones, and seasonal promotions. Multiple codes may drop each month.

Can Anime Final Quest codes be used multiple times?

No. Each code can only be redeemed once per Roblox account.

How to Redeem Codes in Basketball Legends

Redeeming codes in Basketball Legends is quick and works on Roblox for Android, iOS, Mac, and Windows apps.

Just follow these steps:

  1. Open Basketball Legends in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon in the bottom-left corner.
  3. Click Open Codes.
  4. Type or paste the code into the text box.
  5. Hit CLAIM, and your rewards will appear instantly.

If it works, you’ll see “Code has been redeemed,” and the rewards will show up instantly. For boosts, a timer will appear. If it says “Code is expired,” try a different one.

Where to Find More Basketball Legends Codes

Want to grab new codes before anyone else? Here are a few simple ways to stay ahead:

  • Join the official Infinity Sports Discord and check the codes-and-info channel for updates.
  • Follow the developers on Twitter/X for surprise code drops during events or milestones.
  • Bookmark this article, and we will keep it updated so you won’t miss any new rewards.

Tips to Maximize Code Rewards

Want to get the most out of your freebies? Try these tips:

  • Redeem codes as soon as they drop because they can expire quickly.
  • Use boosts like COINBOOST when you can play multiple matches in a row to earn the most coins during that time.
  • Spend coins on upgrades or gear that actually help in matches instead of wasting them.
  • Log in daily so you don’t miss limited-time codes or bonuses.
  • Save spins for when there are special skins or animations you want, so they’re worth it.

Common Issues with Codes (and Fixes)

If a code isn’t working, here are the most common reasons and how to fix them:

  • Double-check the spelling, as codes are case-sensitive.
  • Make sure the code hasn’t expired.
  • Copy and paste codes instead of typing them manually.
  • Log out and back in to refresh the game.
  • Check if the code has already been redeemed by reviewing your inventory or coin balance.
  • Enter the code in the correct menu (Settings > Open Codes).
  • On mobile, remove any hidden spaces when pasting codes, or type them manually.
  • If servers are lagging or your connection is unstable, rejoin the game later and try again.

Final Thoughts

Basketball Legends codes are the easiest way to earn coins, boosts, and rare cosmetics without endless grinding. Redeem them regularly, stay tuned for updates, and you’ll keep your build sharp.

If you spot a new code or find one that no longer works, drop it in the comments. We’ll keep this guide updated so you never miss a free reward.

title.rendered: Star Tower Defense X Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Star Tower Defense X Codes on October 17, 2026

All Star Tower Defense X is a fresh new take on a classic Roblox tower defense game. If you’ve played the original ASTD, you already know how tough it gets to unlock strong anime characters, especially with the gacha system. That’s where codes come in. They give you free Gems, Trait Burners, Cubes, and even more, without grinding.

Let’s break down all the working ASTDX codes, what they give, how to redeem them, and where to find new ones before they expire.

Active All Star Tower Defense X Codes

  • soulworld: 4000 gems, 100 stardust (NEW)
  • nobrandgirls: 4000 gems, 100 stardust (NEW)

  • twete93dont: 2700 Gems, and 170 Stardust
  • tungtungnobannersahur: 2700 Gems, and 170 Stardust
  • cosmicrebel: 2700 Gems, and 170 Stardust
  • omgupdate2026: 2700 Gems, and 170 Stardust (LVL 50+)
  • fordanielxd: 67 Gems, 67 Stardust, and special limited unit (LVL 100+)
  • ultramicro: Gems and Stardust
  • superluffysubcount: Gems and Stardust
  • superdaydaykid100ksubs: Gems and Stardust
  • omgupdate2024: Gems and Stardust

Expired All Star Tower Defense X Codes

100KSUBNAVYXFLAME, 1MGROUPMEMBERS, 24HOURSUPDATE, 2MILFAVORITEUP, 2YEARANNIVERSARY, 2YEARANNIVERSARYDUO, 300KSUBSCRIBERSONYOUTUBE300K, 4PARTYROCKING, 6BILLIONVISITS, 6BILLIONVISTS, ABOUTTIMESNOWRBX2023, ALLSTARSPRING, ANIMECARDBATTLE, ANIMEROULETTE1, ANNIVERSARYASTD, ASTD1MILLIKES, ASTDDEVS, ASTDEGGOPENEDFINALLY, ASTDX2022, BIGCODE3, BIGWINTERUPDATESOON, BLAMSDEFNOTLATE300KCODE, BLAMSPONGE, BLAMSPOT500KCODEUNITRELEASE, CHAINSMOKE91, CONGRATULATIONS2KINGLUFFY, DECEMBER2021, DELAYP, DIABLO12, EATLOTSONTHANKSGIVING, EGOUPDATE, ENUMAELISH2024, FRAUDKUNAUPDATE, GOLDGEMGOLD, HALLOWEEN2022, HAPPY3YEARANNIVERSARY, HAPPYHALLOWEEN2021, HAPPYHOLIDAYS, HAPPYHOLIDAYS1, HAPPYHOLIDAYS2, HAPPYLATEMOTHERSDAY, HAPPYSPOOKYMONTH, HOPE2024, HUNTERSTARPASS, IGOT2LOOK, JULY4THREALUPDATE, KINGLUFFYFAN200K, LVLREQNY, MAINTENACECODE15, MBSHUTDOWN, MELONMEN1, MERRYCHRISTMAS2K21, MINIUPD393, NAVYXFLAME130KNOLEAK, NAVYXFLAME170KYOUTUBEREAL, NAVYXFLAME80KSUBS, NAVYXFLAMELATE200KCODEOMG, NAVYXFLAMEOTHERCODE, NAVYXFLAMEYT80K, NEWAPRILUPDATE, NEWSTARCODE, NEWSTARPASS69, NEWUPDATE1121, NEWUPDATECODE, NEWUPDCODE2, NEWUPDCODE3, NEWWORLD2, NOVEMBERUPDATE, PRECHRIISTMAS2023, ROBLOXYAY, ROLEREWARDCODE, SORRY4DELAY, SORRYFORDELAYUPDATE2, SORRYFORLONGDELAY, SRRY4DELAY, STARDUSTUPDATE, STARSHIPWAY, SUBSCRIBETOBLAMSPOTONYOUTUBE200K, SUBTOBLAMSPOT100KBOA, SUPERWOOP, THANKYOUFOR5BVISITS, THANKYOUFOR6BVISITS, THECITYOFANGELS, THEDRUMSOFLIBERATION, THEDRUMSOFLIBERATION2, THEMADAO, TIMECHAMBERFIX, TOURNAMENTSTART, TRADINGUPDATE, TSUKUYOMI2024, ULTRAMOVE, UNIVERSERESET, UPDATETHISWEEK, VIDEOCODE12135, WINTERBREAKWHEN, WINTERGUY19, WORLD2COMINGSOON, WORLD2ISHERE, WORLD3ISHERE, YOUTUBEKINGLUFFY350KDONE

How to Redeem Codes in All Star Tower Defense X

Redeeming codes in ASTDX is super easy, but you’ll need to make sure you’re using the correct in-game menu:

  1. Open the game on Roblox.
  2. Click the Twitter bird icon in the bottom-left corner.
  3. Type or paste your code into the box.
  4. Click Redeem.

Some codes have level requirements, so if you’re getting an error, try leveling up a bit first.

Where to Find New ASTDX Codes

The devs of ASTDX have been actively sharing new codes during updates, events, or milestones, like total likes or visits. Here’s where to look if you want to find them before everyone else:

  • Twitter: Follow @FruitySama, @GakiRBLX, and @NavyXFlame
  • Discord: The official ASTD Discord server, especially the #game-announcements channel
  • Top Down Games Roblox Group

If you’re too busy grinding or just don’t want to scroll Twitter/Discord daily, bookmark this page and check back whenever there’s an update.

What is All Star Tower Defense X?

ASTDX is the follow-up to the original ASTD and brings a massive upgrade in units, balance, and game modes. You summon powerful anime characters like Goku, Tanjiro, Eren, Naruto, and more, then place them on the map to defend against waves of enemies.

The game has a gacha-style summoning system, so free Gems from codes help a lot if you want a strong team without spending Robux. And with every new update, there’s usually a new batch of units and modes that make grinding even more fun.

Final Tips

  • Try to redeem codes ASAP before they expire or get locked behind higher levels.
  • Play on private servers with certain codes (e.g., LIKEF5 or FORTYFIVELIKES) to make them work.
  • Use your rewards smartly, save Gems for banners featuring powerful units.
  • Don’t skip daily logins and quests. They give extra Gems and Skill Orbs to help you grow even faster.
  • Keep an eye on the code box in-game. It usually hints at which creator or account will drop the next code.

Got a code that worked for you but isn’t listed here? Or one that expired early? Let us know, and we’ll update the list!

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Uma Racing Codes on October 24, 2026

If you love speed and anime-style fun, Uma Racing on Roblox is the perfect mix. Inspired by the hit series Umamusume: Pretty Derby, this game turns you into a lightning-fast racer with horse-like traits, sprinting across tracks instead of riding them. The best part? You can grab free in-game cash using Uma Racing codes to unlock new styles and better abilities without spending Robux.

Let’s get you up to speed with all the active codes and how to use them.

All Working Uma Racing Codes

  • HISHIAMAZONSTUFF: Free rewards (NEW)
  • QOLAGAINNGL: Free rewards (NEW)

Expired Codes

BANNER, SMALLPATCH, HACHIMI, TOKAITEIO, HARUISEVIL, HARUIREVAMP, MOBILEFIXES, UPDATESCHEDULECHANGE, MEJIROMCQUEEN, UPDATEISTOOOLONG, LUNARNEWYEAR, FIXINGSOMETING, HOLLONDELAYCMON, NEXTUMAISONEOFTHESPICATEAM, YAENO, CREEKGOOGOO, SCARLET, BESTMOBILEGAME, FOLLOWMEME, DELAYBOMB, FIFTYTHOUSANDLIKES, FIRSTBUGFIX, IOOKMEMBERS, MBFORANOTHERDELAYBRO, MOBILEBUGSORRY, NEXTUPDATEONETWO, QOLUPDATE, RELEASECUH, SORRYFORDELAY, THANKFORSUPPORTIN, THANKSFOR150K, THREEUMASSOON, UFFUEWANTTOMATO, UPDATEONEONE, VOLFIXINGSTUFFZ

How to Redeem Codes in Uma Racing

Redeeming Uma Racing codes is super easy, but there’s one important step most players miss—you must join the Uma Racing Roblox Group first, or the codes won’t work.

Here’s what to do:

  1. Join the Uma Racing Community group on Roblox.
  2. Launch Uma Racing in Roblox.
  3. Tap the Menu button at the bottom of the screen.
  4. Select the Codes tab.
  5. Type or paste a working code in the box.
  6. Press Enter and enjoy your rewards!

If a code doesn’t work, double-check for typos or make sure it hasn’t expired yet.

Looking for in-game freebies? Check Anime Rangers X codes, Blox Fruits codes, and Volleyball Legends codes for the latest redeemable rewards.

How to Find More Uma Racing Codes

FREEFORTICKETORPULL, NEOGALAXY, BANNER, BESTMOBILEGAME, CREEKGOOGOO, DELAYBOMB, DELAYMBBRO, FIFTYTHOUSANDLIKES, FIRSTBUGFIX, FIXINGSOMETING, FOLLOWMEME, HACHIMI, HARUIREVAMP, HARUISEVIL, HOLLONDELAYCMON, IOOKMEMBERS, LUNARNEWYEAR, MBFORANOTHERDELAYBRO, MEJIROMCQUEEN, MOBILEBUGSORRY, MOBILEFIXES, NEXTUMAISONEOFTHESPICATEAM, NEXTUPDATEONETWO, PLAYTEST, QOLUPDATE, RELEASECUH, SCARLET, SMALLPATCH, SORRYFORBUG, SORRYFORDELAY, THANKFORSUPPORTIN, THANKSFOR150K, THREEUMASSOON, TOKAITEIO, UFFUEWANTTOMATO, UPDATEISTOOOLONG, UPDATEONEONE, UPDATESCHEDULECHANGE, VOLFIXINGSTUFFZ, YAENO

Troubleshooting Uma Racing Codes Not Working

If your Uma Racing codes aren’t working, don’t panic. Here are a few quick fixes that usually solve the issue:

  1. Join the official group – You must be part of the Uma Racing Community Roblox group to redeem any codes.
  2. Check for typos – Codes are case-sensitive, so make sure every letter and number is correct.
  3. Avoid expired codes – Some codes stop working after a few days or updates.
  4. Restart the game – If the code still doesn’t work, rejoin the server and try again.
  5. Check internet stability – Sometimes a poor connection causes the code system not to register.

Tips to Earn More Rewards in Uma Racing

  • Join events and tournaments – Developers often hand out free codes or rewards during big updates.
  • Participate in Discord giveaways – The official Discord regularly hosts events with bonus prizes.
  • Train and race daily – The more races you complete, the more in-game cash you earn naturally.
  • Upgrade Uma styles strategically – Invest in the ones that boost your speed and stability first.
  • Use MVPs and emotes – These not only look great but sometimes unlock hidden achievements and bonuses.

Conclusion

Uma Racing keeps getting better with every update, and these codes are the easiest way to stay ahead without grinding too hard. Make sure to redeem them quickly, join the community for more updates, and keep racing to unlock the rarest Uma styles. The faster you move, the more rewards you’ll collect, so hit the track and show everyone what real speed looks like!

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Roblox Subterra Codes on October 01, 2026

If you’re deep into mining in Roblox Subterra and want a boost, you’re in the right place. Whether you’re here to dodge monsters, upgrade your gear, or just hoard chrono shards, redeeming Subterra codes is the easiest way to get ahead without the grind.

These codes give you free chrono shards, EXP boosts, gold, and even rare keys. New codes drop often after major updates or when the devs hit community milestones, so check back frequently.

All working Roblox Subterra codes

  • 25KMEMBERS: 280 Chrono Shards (NEW)
  • UPDATE1.4.50: 280 Chrono Shards (NEW)
  • 1YEAR: Chrono Shards
  • FEATURED: Chrono Shards
  • CRASHFIX?: 280 chrono shards
  • LUNAREVENTS: 280 chrono shards
  • 8KMEMBERS: 280 chrono shards
  • UPDATE1.3: 140 chrono shards
  • 3MVISITS: 280 chrono shards
  • PATCH104: double EXP for one hour
  • HOTFIX102: 280 chrono shards and one frozen key
  • 20KLIKES: 420 chrono shards

Expired Subterra codes

100KFAVS, 180FAVS, 2MVISITS, 6KMEMBERS, BETTERSTORAGE, BETTERTOGETHER, ERRORED, MAJORUPDATE

How to redeem codes in Subterra

Not sure how to use the codes? It’s super easy:

  1. Launch Subterra on Roblox.
  2. Go to the Codes NPC on the right side of the spawn area.
  3. Type or paste a working code into the box.
  4. Press Claim Code to collect your reward.

Make sure you enter the code exactly as shown; some are case-sensitive.

What is Subterra?

Subterra is a 2D mining adventure where you explore underground caves, fight monsters, and collect resources. It feels like a mix of Minecraft and Terraria, but with a fixed camera and cool progression. The deeper you go, the better loot you find—but also, the harder it gets to survive.

As you play, you unlock stronger gear, find keys to special chests, and use crafting to build potions and tools. The game is chill when you want it to be, but it can also turn chaotic when you’re low on health and cornered by monsters.

Where to find more codes

Codes usually drop during major updates or when the devs hit community goals, such as player count or likes. To stay ahead:

  • Join the Polyworks Studio group on Roblox
  • Follow the Subterra Discord server (check the announcements channel)
  • Bookmark this page for the latest working codes

If a code doesn’t work, try restarting the game or double-checking your spelling.

Whether you’re just starting out or grinding for the top-tier loot, Subterra codes are the perfect shortcut. Don’t miss your freebies; they really do make your next mining run a lot smoother.

title.rendered: Project Slayers Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Project Slayers Codes on October 01, 2026

Project Slayers is one of those Roblox games that pulls you in slowly and then refuses to let go. From choosing between becoming a Demon Slayer or turning into a demon, every decision affects how strong your character becomes. Progress takes time, and that is exactly why codes matter so much in this game. They help you reset mistakes, reroll clans or breathing styles, and get spins without grinding for hours.

If you are looking for the latest Project Slayers codes, here is the current situation.

All Active Project Slayers Codes

Currently, there are no active codes available. Developers release new codes during events and updates, so check back soon!

Project Slayers doesn’t have any active codes right now. We’ll add new codes here as soon as they become available.

That said, new codes are released when the game is updated. Bookmarking this page remains the safest way to catch them early, before they expire again.

Expired Project Slayers Codes

SORYAGAINGUYS:V, 1MILLFAVS, 1MILLFAVSBREATHRESET, 1MILLFAVSRACERESET, 200K+UPVOTESTYSM, 300KLIKES!, 350KUPVOTES!, 350KUPVOTES!BREATHING, 400KLIKES, 400KLIKESBREATHINGRESET, 400KLIKESRACERESET, AKAZAGOBRR, ANOTHERDAYANOTHERSHUTDOWN, CHRISTMAS2023BREATHING, CHRISTMAS2023RACE, CHRISTMAS2023SPINS, FINALLYRELEASETIME!, FLAM3!SHAWCAS31, GETTINGTHERE!, INCREASEDDROPSBREATHRESET, INCREASEDDROPSRACERESET, LASTCODE?LOL, MINIUPDATE, MINIUPDATE3, MINIUPDATE3BREATHINGRESET, MINIUPDATE3RACERESET, MINIUPDATEDAILY, MUGENTRAINFINALLY, NEWYEAR2024BREATHING, NEWYEAR2024RACE, NEWYEAR2024SPINS, SCYTH3SHOWCASE!, SHUTDOWN!, SHUTDOWNNUMB2, SORRYFORSHUTDOWNS!, STONE_BREATHING_RACE_RESET, STONE_BREATHING_SPINS, THANKSFOR350MVISITS, THXFOR400MVISITS, THXFOR650KVOTES, TWITTASPINS, UPD295MINICODE, UPD@TE1B1GCODE, UPDATE309ARTSPINS, UPDATE309BREATHINGRESET, UPDATE309RACERESET, WEREBACKUP

How to Redeem Project Slayers Codes

Redeeming codes in Project Slayers is simple once you know where to look. There are two working methods, and both do the same thing.

Method 1: From the Main Menu

  1. Launch Project Slayers on Roblox
  2. Stay on the main menu and hover over Play.
  3. Click the gift box icon.
  4. Enter the code in the text box.
  5. Press Submit Code.

Method 2: Inside the Game

  1. Spawn into the game.
  2. Press M on your keyboard.
  3. Click the Book icon.
  4. Enter the code at the bottom of the menu.
  5. Hit Submit Code.

On mobile, tap and hold to open menus, then use the book icon to find the code box.

Why Project Slayers Codes Stop Working

Most Project Slayers codes expire quickly because of the game’s large and active player base. When a code stays live too long, it can break balance by giving too many free resets and spins. That is why codes often vanish without warning.

If a code fails to redeem, double check spelling first. If it still does not work, it has already expired. Trying multiple invalid codes can also trigger a short cooldown, so wait a few seconds before trying again.

How to Find New Project Slayers Codes

The developers do not follow a fixed schedule for releasing codes, which makes tracking them frustrating. Still, there are a few reliable places where new codes usually appear first.

  • The official Project Slayers Discord server
  • The game’s Trello board
  • Update announcements during major patches or events

Since Discord invites are sometimes closed, your best option is to bookmark this page and check back after updates.

What Rewards Do Project Slayers Codes Give?

Based on past releases, future codes are likely to include:

  • Clan spins
  • Demon Art spins
  • Daily spins
  • Race resets
  • Breathing resets
  • XP or Wen

These rewards directly affect your build, which is why missing a code can feel painful, especially early in the game.

Final Thoughts

Project Slayers is not generous with codes, but when they do appear, they are valuable. A single reset can save hours of grinding and completely change how strong your character feels. Even though there are no active codes right now, history shows that new ones return during updates and milestones.

Keep this page bookmarked, check back after big updates, and be ready to redeem codes the moment they go live. In Project Slayers, timing is everything.

  • Blue Lock Rivals Codes
  • Hunty Zombie Codes
  • Roblox Slayers 2 codes

Redeeming codes in Shindo Life is easy, but they’re case-sensitive, one wrong letter and it won’t work. Follow these steps carefully:

  3. On the right side, find the YOUTUBE CODE box.

Developers at RELL Games often share new codes on:

Sometimes your Shindo Life codes might not work, and it can happen for a few reasons. Here’s a breakdown:

  • Spelling or Case Errors: Codes are case-sensitive. Even one wrong letter or symbol will make it invalid.
  • Extra Spaces or Typos: Adding spaces before or after a code can cause an “invalid” error. Always copy and paste carefully.
  • Server Delays: Sometimes the game servers lag or need refreshing before codes register correctly.

Even without codes, there are other ways to earn Spins:

Shindo Life can be grind-heavy. Spins decide your Bloodline, the unique abilities and powers your character gets. Codes are the fastest way to earn Spins and RELL Coins without spending Robux or hours grinding. Events like the game’s 5th Anniversary often drop a ton of free codes, so it’s worth keeping an eye out.

title.rendered: iPhone 17e vs iPhone 17: What You Give Up for $200 Less

content.rendered:
Apple just unveiled iPhone 17e, which costs $200 less than the base iPhone 17 model. iPhone 17 is already considered a bang-for-the-buck iPhone, bringing features like a ProMotion display and a 48MP camera that were previously limited to Pro models. 

So, if you are considering getting a new iPhone for a reasonable price, should you choose the iPhone 17e or the iPhone 17? What are the differences between them, and which model fits your specific needs best? We’ll go through everything.

Table of Contents
  • iPhone 17e vs iPhone 17: Quick Specs at a Glance
  • Design and Feel: The Difference Is in the Details
  • Display: The iPhone 17’s Clearest Win
  • Performance: Close Enough for Most People
  • Cameras: Where the 17e Starts to Feel “Budget.”
  • Battery and Charging: Should Decide Between Capacity or Speed
  • Connectivity: Premium Extras vs. the Essentials
  • So, Which One Should You Buy?

iPhone 17e vs iPhone 17: Quick Specs at a Glance

Before diving into the detailed breakdown, here is a side-by-side overview of the core hardware and positioning differences.

The difference of $200 is clearly visible on paper. While both phones come with the same chip, the iPhone 17 easily takes the lead in terms of camera, charging speeds, and GPU. However, let’s dive into a detailed comparison of each to check how much it even impacts day-to-day use.

Design and Feel: The Difference Is in the Details

The major difference we will notice right away is that the iPhone 17e comes with a notch instead of Dynamic Island. Therefore, you will also miss all the dynamic notification features that come with it.

Second, buttons. The iPhone 17 includes the Camera Control button. The 17e does not. Whether you love that button or ignore it, its presence is part of Apple’s upsell.

Finally, they differ in the available color options. The 17e keeps a smaller set, with Soft Pink as the standout, while the 17 gets more options like Lavender, Sage, and Mist Blue.

The iPhone 17e is also noticeably lighter in hand, as it comes with a 6.1-inch display instead of 6.3 inches like the iPhone 17. So, let’s get into the details about the display.

Display: The iPhone 17’s Clearest Win

Apart from not supporting Dynamic Island, the iPhone 17e also does not support 120Hz ProMotion and Always-On Display. The iPhone 17 is also noticeably brighter, with 3000 nits of brightness compared to the iPhone 17e’s 1200 nits. In day-to-day usage, you can consider the iPhone 17 to be at least 25% brighter than the 17e.

However, the display resolution is the same on both devices at 460 ppi. Also, the 17e has a 6.1-inch display, so it’s a bit smaller compared to the iPhone 17. At the end of the day, both displays are excellent and can get the job done, but the 17 takes an easy win with the display and may even be worth the additional $200 for many people based on the display upgrade alone.

Performance: Close Enough for Most People

Both phones use the A19 with a 6-core CPU and a 16-core Neural Engine. The major caveat is that the iPhone 17e version is slightly cut down on the GPU, one fewer GPU core than the iPhone 17. However, this should not majorly change your experience unless you are a heavy gamer or render videos regularly on your iPhone. 

Both iPhone 17 and iPhone 17e come with 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM as standard, with no higher RAM options available. 

Cameras: Where the 17e Starts to Feel “Budget.”

After the display, this is the second big fork in the road for the iPhone 17e. It comes with a single 48MP main camera. It is repeatedly described as capable for standard shots, with 2x in-sensor zoom, and generally similar in output to the iPhone 17’s main camera in many situations.

The iPhone 17 adds a second rear camera: a 48MP ultrawide. That single addition is the difference that makes the iPhone 17 a better option if you consider the camera category when choosing to buy one.

On the front, the iPhone 17 gets an 18MP Center Stage camera, while the 17e keeps a 12MP TrueDepth-style camera. However, features like Center Stage are available on both, adding a meaningful quality-of-life upgrade.

Battery and Charging: Should Decide Between Capacity or Speed

The iPhone 17 has a 3,692 mAh battery capacity, while the iPhone 17e features around 4,005 mAh. However, Apple claims iPhone 17 is more efficient and supports up to 30 hours of video playback compared to 17e’s reported 26 hours of playback. 

However, in reality, iPhone 17e has a 60Hz, less bright display, with the same A19 chip. Technically, it should be more efficient than a power-hungry 120 Hz display on the iPhone 17. 

What does this mean for you? Both phones should comfortably last a full day for most users. The iPhone 17 has strong official endurance numbers, while the iPhone 17e has the hardware profile to potentially stretch even further in lighter use. If battery life is your absolute top priority, the 17e could turn out to be the quiet winner, but both are positioned as reliable all-day devices.

Charging speed is easier to separate. The iPhone 17 supports significantly faster wired charging, up to 40W, and faster MagSafe charging up to 25W. The iPhone 17e is rated at around 20W wired and 15W MagSafe.

In practical terms, the iPhone 17 will refill noticeably quicker when you plug it in or drop it on a MagSafe charger. If you frequently top up before heading out, the faster charging on the iPhone 17 is a real convenience advantage.

Connectivity: Premium Extras vs. the Essentials

Connectivity is not something most people focus on, but it affects how future-proof a phone feels. The iPhone 17e uses Apple’s in-house C1X modem, while the iPhone 17 uses a Qualcomm modem and is positioned with broader 5G support in certain regions. In everyday use, both support modern 5G and will feel fast, but the iPhone 17 is built for higher peak performance and wider compatibility where available.

The difference continues with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The iPhone 17 supports newer wireless standards and more advanced connectivity features, making it better prepared for faster networks and newer accessories over time.

That said, the iPhone 17e still supports modern Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and 5G, which is more than enough for most people. Streaming, browsing, gaming, video calls, and downloads should feel equally fast and stable in daily use.

Where the iPhone 17 pulls ahead is long-term flexibility. If you plan to keep your phone for several years and want the widest compatibility with future networks and accessories, it offers that extra margin. If you simply need reliable connectivity that works well today, the iPhone 17e delivers without feeling limited.

So, Which One Should You Buy?

If you want the most iPhone for the least money, the iPhone 17e makes sense. It gives you the modern A19 platform, current software, MagSafe, and a strong main camera at $599. For many buyers, that is enough.

If you are paying for comfort and polish, the iPhone 17 is the easier phone to recommend. The 120Hz ProMotion display with Always-On is the upgrade you feel constantly. The ultrawide camera is the upgrade that expands what your phone can do. Faster charging and the more modern front design are the kind of features that age well.

If you plan to buy the iPhone 17e, pairing it with one of the best iPhone 17e cases can help protect it from accidental drops and scratches

title.rendered: Download Official iPhone 17e Wallpapers in 4K

content.rendered:
After much speculation, Apple has launched the successor of the budget “e” lineup, the iPhone 17e. Positioned as a stylish and performance-focused addition, the iPhone 17e brings an updated A19 chip with C1X modem, Ceramic Shield 2, better camera, and a brand-new set of vibrant wallpapers that perfectly match its new color options.

The good news is that you can enjoy these stock wallpapers right now on your device; there’s no need to wait or buy the new iPhone. Here, we have curated the official iPhone 17e wallpaper in 4K resolution so you can download it for free.

iPhone 17e Wallpapers

Apple introduced the iPhone 17e on March 2, 2026, and with it came a set of new official wallpapers designed to match the phone’s aesthetic. They pair beautifully with the device’s color finishes: Soft Pink, White, and Black.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest MotoRush Codes on October 24, 2026

Racing a superbike in Roblox feels like a dream when you first start MotoRush. You get a bike, a city full of open roads, and a track where you can push speed like a MotoGP racer. The only problem is cash. Bikes cost a lot, and the starter money is tiny. That’s where MotoRush codes save you.

MotoRush lets you spawn sports bikes, explore the map, build your skills, and race with friends. But buying new bikes or swapping parts takes cash, and you can run out quickly. Codes give you free rewards so you can upgrade without waiting for hours.

Active MotoRush Codes

  • SummerEnd?!: 1k Cash (NEW)
  • Barva!: Redeem for 2000 Cash
  • S ummerEnd?!: 1,000 Cash

Expired MotoRush Codes

1000LIKES, 100KFAV!, 100KLIKES!, 100LIKES, 10KLIKES, 123KFAV, 170KFAV!, 17MVISITS!, 1MVISITS, 2000LIKES, 20KLIKES, 20MVISITS, 25MVISITS, 2KLIKES, 30KLIKES, 30MVISITS?, 3KLIKES, 40KLIKES, 50KLIKES, 5KLIKES, 75KLIKESYIPPIE!!!, 8MVISITS, 90%LIKES, 90KLIKES!, APRILFOOOLS!!!, AREYOUREADY?!, FREEBIKE, GAMERELEASE, HALLOWEEN, HALLOWEEN2025, MOTORUSHONTOP, NEWUPDATE, READYFORNEWMAP?!, SNOW!, THEGAMES, TRACK, TRACK!, UPD?!, UPDATE, VALENTINES, ‘123KFAV!

How to Redeem MotoRush Codes

Using codes takes only a few seconds.

  1. Open MotoRush on Roblox.
  2. Click the Gift icon on the right.
  3. Enter or paste a working code.
  4. Press Claim and get your reward.

Enjoyed these codes? Be sure to visit our pages for Midnight Racing Tokyo codes, Roblox Meta Lock codes, and Project Blue Lock codes to grab more free rewards across popular Roblox games.

What MotoRush Is About

MotoRush is a bike racing simulator on Roblox. You start with a basic bike, earn cash by riding, and try different bikes with unique speeds and handling. You can free roam the city or join track races. Every minute you ride gives money, so even casual play helps you buy your dream bike.

MotoRush feels satisfying because the bikes look good and the speed feels real for a Roblox game. Boosts, handling, and tricks make the game exciting, especially when you try to beat your friends.

Why Codes Matter

Codes help you skip the slow grind. Normally, you need to ride a long time to collect enough cash. With free cash from codes, you can unlock better bikes early. It also helps new players catch up with others.

If you redeem codes early, you build a garage faster. That means more speed, better visuals, and more fun with your squad.

How to Find More MotoRush Codes

MotoRush codes release randomly. They often drop when the game gets new likes, hits a milestone, or during events.

The best places to find new codes:

  • Bookmark this page and check again.
  • Join the MotoRush Discord server.
  • Follow MotoRush Inc. on X.
  • Join the MotoRush Inc. Roblox group.

Staying updated helps you grab rewards before they expire.

Why MotoRush Codes Stop Working

If a code shows “Invalid”, it has expired. Sometimes code breaks because of small typing mistakes. Always copy and paste the codes exactly.

Final Thoughts

MotoRush is a perfect game for players who like clean racing, speed, and showing off new bikes. Codes make the journey easier by giving early upgrades. The thrill of buying a new bike without grinding for hours feels good.

As MotoRush grows, more codes will release. New maps, new bikes, and new updates usually bring new rewards. Keep riding, keep winning, and check for fresh codes often.

If you want similar games, try Motorcycle Racing or Bike League. And if racing is not your style, jump into our full Roblox codes list to find something you love.

  • Anime Ascendants Codes

title.rendered: iPhone 17e: Specs, Features, Price, and Everything You Need to Know

content.rendered:
Apple has officially unveiled the iPhone 17e, its newest affordable addition to the iPhone 17 series. It brings powerful performance, great camera capabilities, and enhanced durability at a competitive price point.

In this detailed deep-dive, I’ll share all key aspects of the iPhone 17e, including its release date, specs, standout features, pricing details, design, camera tech, and more.

Table of Contents
  • iPhone 17e: Full Specifications
  • iPhone 17e: Key Features and Upgrades
    • 1. Powerful Performance with A19 Chip
    • 2. Advanced Camera System
    • 3. Stunning Display and Design
    • 4. Battery, Charging & Connectivity
    • 5. iOS 26 & Apple Intelligence
  • iPhone 17e: Price & Availability
  • Final Verdict: Is iPhone 17e Worth It?

iPhone 17e: Full Specifications

iPhone 17e: Key Features and Upgrades

Apple has included several iPhone 17 features and upgraded performance than the previous budget models in iPhone 17e, making it perfect for users who want flagship-class technology without the flagship price.

1. Powerful Performance with A19 Chip

At the heart of the iPhone 17e lies Apple’s latest A19 chip, built using advanced 3-nanometer technology. This chip has 6-core CPU and 4-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, delivering same performance as iPhone 17. It supports full suite of Apple Intelligence and powerful machine-learning tasks.

Moreover, Apple has integrated the latest-generation C1X cellular modem, which is up to 2x faster than the C1 modem in iPhone 16e. This translates into longer battery performance, better connectivity, smooth performance with the ability to multitask, console-quality AAA games, and a future-proofed performance level—all from a ‘budget’ iPhone.

2. Advanced Camera System

The iPhone 17e packs a 48 MP Fusion camera, which is more than just a megapixel boost. It introduces:

  • Optical-quality 2× telephoto for closer shots without quality loss
  • Next-generation Portrait mode with Focus and Depth Control (recognizes people, pets, etc.)
  • 4K Dolby Vision video up to 60 fps
  • Night mode and improved HDR for low-light photos

You can capture super-high-resolution photos in both 24MP and 48MP resolutions and make it frame-worthy with Photographic Styles. Overall, this camera system delivers impressive shots and videos even in challenging conditions.

In the front, the same 12MP sensor is carried over.

3. Stunning Display and Design

The iPhone 17e sports a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with Ceramic Shield 2 front cover and improved anti-reflection coating. So, you get up to 3× better scratch resistance, Dolby Vision streaming, excellent color accuracy, and reduced glare.

For the build, Apple has used a durable aerospace-grade aluminum frame with IP68 water and dust resistance and three vibrant colors. It also retains Face ID and introduces an Action button for quick access to favorite functions. However, the old generation notch is still present on the display top.

4. Battery, Charging & Connectivity

The iPhone 17e ensures reliable 26 hours battery life thanks to efficient silicon and smart power management. Charging and connectivity highlights include:

  • USB-C support
  • Fast wired charging (up to 50 % in ~30 min)
  • MagSafe & Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W
  • Next-gen C1X cellular modem with up to 2× faster speeds than its predecessor
  • Satellite features like Emergency SOS, Messages, and Find My via satellite for off-grid connectivity.

5. iOS 26 & Apple Intelligence

Running on iOS 26, the iPhone 17e brings:

  • A redesigned interface
  • Powerful Apple Intelligence features
  • Live translation in Messages and FaceTime
  • Enhanced visual intelligence and system-wide smart tools

This makes everyday tasks easier and more intuitive, especially when paired with Apple’s ecosystem.

iPhone 17e: Price & Availability

Apple has positioned the iPhone 17e as a value leader in its lineup:

  • Starts at $599 (base model with 256 GB storage)
  • Available in 256 GB and 512 GB configurations
  • Available colors: Black, White, and Soft Pink
  • Pre-orders began March 4, 2026
  • General availability from March 11, 2026, in over 70+ markets worldwide

Final Verdict: Is iPhone 17e Worth It?

Pros

  • Excellent performance with the A19 chip
  • Big storage from the base model
  • Impressive camera for photos & videos 
  • MagSafe wireless charging support
  • Durable design and long battery life

Cons

  • Lacks some premium features like Dynamic Island, Wi-Fi 7, dual camera
  • Design remains familiar and not radically new

If you’re looking for a powerful iPhone with a future-proofed performance level without the need to pay a premium price tag, especially with the camera and battery performance at a high level, then the iPhone 17e is the way to go. Whether you are upgrading from an older iPhone model or switching from an Android device, this phone is worth considering.

But for tech enthusiasts who want to experience the latest and greatest features, such as 120Hz screens and multiple camera arrays, the iPhone 17 Pro series might still be worth considering.

Related articles worth reading:

  • Everything we know about the upcoming AirPods Pro 3
  • 11 Reasons why buying the iPhone 17 could be totally worth it

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Attack on Titan Revolution Codes on October 01, 2026

If you’re playing Attack on Titan: Revolution (AOTR) on Roblox, codes are one of the fastest ways to get ahead. They give you free Spins, Emperor Keys, and temporary boosts that help you unlock better Families, level up faster, and progress without grinding for hours.

All Working Attack on Titan Revolution Codes

  • LIKES1M400K: 300 Spins, 1 2x Luck Potion [1H], 1 2x Gold Potion [1H], 1 2x XP Potion [1H], and 10 Emperor Keys (NEW)

Expired Attack on Titan Revolution Codes

How to Redeem Attack on Titan Revolution Codes

Before redeeming codes, make sure you meet one requirement: your character must be at least Level 15. Without that, codes won’t work.

Once you’re eligible, follow these steps:

  1. Open Attack on Titan: Revolution on Roblox.
  2. From the main menu, click the Codes option.
  3. Enter the working code in the text box.
  4. Click Redeem to instantly receive your rewards.

Looking for more freebies? Check out the latest Anime Eternal codes, Anime Crusaders codes, and Borderlands 4 SHiFT codes for even more free rewards.

Why Your AOTR Codes Might Not Work?

If a code doesn’t redeem, there are usually only two reasons. Either the code has expired, or it was entered incorrectly. Codes are case-sensitive, so copying and pasting is strongly recommended.

How to Get More Attack on Titan Revolution Codes

New AOTR codes usually drop during updates, milestones, or major fixes. If you want them as soon as they go live, check these official sources:

  • The AoT: Revolution Discord server (announcements channel)
  • The developer’s X account: @_EvolutionPower
  • The official Attack on Titan Revolution Roblox page

Alternatively, you can just bookmark our page to check for the latest codes. 

What Is Attack on Titan Revolution?

Attack on Titan: Revolution is a Roblox action RPG inspired by the Attack on Titan anime and manga. You play as a Survey Corps recruit, using ODM gear to fight Titans, unlock powerful Families, and upgrade your character through Spins and perks.

If you’re actively playing, redeeming codes regularly is one of the easiest ways to stay competitive without unnecessary grinding.

  • Parkour Champions Codes
  • Demonfall Codes

title.rendered: Project Egoist Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Project Egoist Codes on October 01, 2026

Project Egoist is one of those Roblox games that takes you from “I’ll play one match” to hours of trying to perfect a stylish goal. The game is inspired by Blue Lock, and, like the anime, it pushes you to chase that egoist spark within you. Every match feels intense, and getting better styles through the gacha system makes a massive difference. That’s where codes become a lifesaver. They give you free Yen and rewards without having to grind forever.

Active Project Egoist Codes

  • MVPBUGFIX: Redeem for 7,500 Cash (NEW)
  • THENINJA: Redeem for 15,000 Cash (NEW)
  • NEWERA: Redeem for 7,500 Cash (NEW)
  • UPDATEGIFT: Redeem for 25 Gems (NEW)

Expired Project Egoist Codes

10KACTIVE, 10KEVENTFOLLOW, 10KLIKES, 10KSUBS, 1MVISITS, 20KLIKES, 5KINTEREST, 60KFOLLOWEVENT, BACHIRA, BAROU, BUGFIX, CHEMICALREACTION, CHIGIRI, DELAYED, DELAYED3, DELAYED4, DELAYED5, DELAYED99, DELAYREWARD, EVENTFOLLOWREWARD, FORTHEUNLUCKYTRYAGAIN, GAGAMARU, GAMEISBACK, HBDSOKAKU, HOTFIX2, HOWDIDTHEYUSEITTWICE, HUGEDELAYREWARD, ITOSHIRIN, KUNIGAMI, KURONA, KURONA2, KURONABUFF, LAZYGENIUSREWORK, MAPRANDOMIZE, MEFIXTHEBIGBUG, MONSTER, NELISAGI, NEWRARITY, NUMWATERONE, NXRDLY, PROJECTEGOIST, PROJECTEGOISTRELEASE, PROJECTPINGFIXED, PROJECTXMAS, QOLUPDATEKURONA, SHIDOURYUSEI, SHUTDOWNFIX, SOMANYEMOTES, SPECIALCODE, STOREISSUE, THANKSFOR10KFOLLOWEVENT, THANKSFOR5KFOLLOWEVENT, THEACEEATER, THEDEMONKING, THEEMPEROR, THEKING, THESHARK, UPDATE4DELAY, UPDATE5DELAY, UPDATEDELAY, WEAKGKTHROW, YUKIMIYA

How to Redeem Project Egoist Codes

Before you try to redeem a code, make sure you are a member of the Roblox group “Cool group for big cool people”. If you skip that step, the codes won’t work no matter what.

Once you’ve joined the group, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Project Egoist on Roblox.
  2. Click the “Codes” button at the bottom of the screen (ticket icon).
  3. Type any working code from the list.
  4. Press Redeem to claim your rewards instantly.

Why Your Code Might Not Work

If the code shows “invalid”, it usually means one of two things. Either the code has expired, or you’ve typed it incorrectly. These codes are case sensitive, so even one extra letter or space can break them. Copying and pasting is always the safest method.

How to Get More Project Egoist Codes

Codes are usually shared by the developers during big updates or delays. The fastest way to find new codes is through the Project Egoist Discord server, especially the announcements and updates channels. Codes also appear in the Roblox group sometimes, but they show up there later than they do on Discord.

For players who don’t want to chase codes everywhere, bookmark our page. We will update this page when new codes drop. 

Get More Game Codes:

  • Clover Retribution Codes
  • Hunty Zombie Codes
  • Uma Racing Codes
  • Shindo Life Codes

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Slap Battles Codes on October 17, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes in Slap Battles, you already know how simple and chaotic the game feels at first. You slap, get slapped, fall off the map, and slowly learn that every slap matters. Slaps unlock gloves, abilities, and progress, so naturally, players keep looking for codes that can give them a small but useful boost.

This is where Slap Battles codes usually come in. They do not appear often, and when they do, they tend to disappear quickly. So if you are checking this page, you are doing the right thing.

All New Working Slap Battles Codes

  • EvilCatseye: 50 Null shards (NEW)
  • -: –

Expired Slap Battles Codes

1X1X1X1X1X1, ARCWASHERE, BEGINNER, BEMYAWESOMEVALENTINE, BOBAWASHERE, BOING, DELAYLIS, DELAYUF, E4RTH, HAPPY5LAPPIVERSARY, HAPPYNEWYEAR, LONEORANGE, MORTLS, MUT4TE, ONEMILLIONLIKES, SPL4SH, SPOOKYSEASON25

How to Redeem Slap Battles Codes

Redeeming codes in Slap Battles is not as straightforward as in most Roblox games. First, you need at least 1000 slaps to redeem codes from your account. Once you have enough slaps, follow these steps:

  1. Open Slap Battles from its official Roblox game page.
  2. Click the Twitter bird icon on the left side of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code into the text box.
  4. Press the Redeem button to claim your reward.

title.rendered: Blox Fruits Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Blox Fruits Codes on October 01, 2026

Blox Fruits is easily one of the biggest Roblox games out there. Whether you’re grinding to become the strongest pirate or marine, the game’s endless quests, devil fruits, and boss fights can pull you in for hours. But let’s be honest, leveling up can be slow and painful without a little boost. That’s where Blox Fruits codes come in. These codes give you double XP, stat resets, and a bit of Beli (money) to make the grind smoother.

All Working Blox Fruits Codes

  • EASTEREXP: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • KITT_RESET: Free Stat Refund
  • CHANDLER: Redeem for $0 (simply a joke)
  • SUB2CAPTAINMAUI: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Enyu_is_Pro: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Starcodeheo: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Sub2Fer999: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Magicbus: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • JCWK: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • kittgaming: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Bluxxy: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • fudd10_v2: Redeem for $2
  • SUB2GAMERROBOT_EXP1: 2x EXP for 30 minutes
  • SUB2GAMERROBOT_RESET1: Free Stat Refund
  • Sub2UncleKizaru: Free Stat Refund
  • Axiore: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Sub2Daigrock: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Bignews: In game Title “Big News”
  • Sub2NoobMaster123: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • StrawHatMaine: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • TantaiGaming: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • TheGreatAce: 2x EXP for 20 minutes
  • Fudd10: Redeem for $1
  • Sub2OfficialNoobie: 2x EXP for 20 minutes

These boosts may not make you overpowered instantly, but if you redeem all of them back-to-back, you can easily stack around 3–4 hours of double XP. That’s a huge time-saver if you’re grinding for levels or farming bosses.

Want more freebies? Don’t miss our Clover Retribution codes, Dress to Impress codes, and Jujutsu Infinite codes to score rewards in other popular Roblox games.

Expired Blox Fruits Codes

15B_BESTBROTHERS, 1BILLION, 1LOSTADMIN, 1MLIKES_RESET, 24NOADMIN, 2BILLION, ADMINDARES, ADMINFIGHT, ADMINHACKED, ADMIN_STRENGTH, ADMIN_TROLL, BANEXPLOIT, BOSSBUILD, CODESLIDE, CODE_SERVICIO, DEVSCOOKING, DRAGONABUSE, EARN_FRUITS, E_SERVICIO, FIGHT4FRUIT, GETPRANKED, GIFTING_HOURS, KRAZYDARES, LIGHTNINGABUSE, NEWTROLL, NOEXPLOITER, NOMOREHACK, NOOB2ADMIN, NOOB2PRO, REWARDFUN, SEATROLLING, SECRET_ADMIN, TRIPLEABUSE

How to Redeem Blox Fruits Codes

If you’ve never redeemed a code before, don’t worry, it’s simple and takes less than a minute.

  1. Open Blox Fruits in Roblox.
  2. Choose your side, Pirates or Marines.
  3. Select the Cog icon and then choose Redeem Codes option.
  4. Enter any code in the pop-up box that says “Reward Codes.”
  5. Hit Redeem and enjoy your free rewards.

Make sure you’re ready before redeeming XP codes because the timer starts the moment you hit redeem. If you’re planning a long grinding session, activate multiple EXP codes back-to-back to keep your boost going.

How to Get New Blox Fruits Codes

The best way to get new Blox Fruits codes is by following Gamer Robot Inc., the game’s developer, on Discord and X (Twitter). They usually release new codes whenever a big update drops or when a new Blox Bulletin video goes live. You can also find them in the #server-announcements channel on their Discord server.

If you don’t want to keep checking manually, you can bookmark this article, we will update this article as soon as we find new codes. 

You can also grab extra gifts after a quick server shutdown for bug fixes—just visit Event Island within minutes of it reopening.

A Few Tips to Earn More Beli

While codes can help, the fastest way to earn money in Blox Fruits is by hunting treasure chests. These spawn frequently across the map and give quick Beli boosts. Middle Island in the First Sea is a great spot, check the docks, trees, and rooftops for chests. They respawn every few minutes, and if you hop servers, you can collect them again endlessly.

Final Thoughts

Even without new codes dropping every week, there are still plenty of active ones to help you out. Whether you’re grinding to unlock rare devil fruits, fighting sea beasts, or just exploring the islands, these Blox Fruits codes make the experience less of a grind and more of an adventure.

So, before you set sail again, make sure to redeem them all, and who knows, maybe the next big update will come with another batch of surprises.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Weak Legacy 2 Codes on October 01, 2026

Weak Legacy 2 codes are free promo codes released by the developers to give players spins, clan rerolls, race resets, and breathing or blood art resets. These rewards directly affect your build, progression speed, and overall experience, especially in a game where RNG plays a big role.

Codes are usually tied to updates, milestones, reworks, or bug fixes, and many of them expire quickly or only work in new or private servers. This guide keeps things simple and accurate. You’ll find the current working codes, a clear list of expired ones, exact redemption steps, common fixes, and official places to track new codes.

All Working Weak Legacy 2 Codes

  • 500KLIKES!: 2 Crystal essence, 25 Spins, and 1 Fate Spin (NEW)
  • HAPPYEASTER!: 20 Spins and 5 Fate Spins (NEW)
  • BLOODV2UPDGORARRRT: Reset breathing/ art potion (NEW)
  • HPPYSAINTPATRICKS: 100k Yen and Reset potion
  • SENIORISTHEGOAT: Reset Breathing or 1 Art Potion
  • ENTDISTRICTUPD: 100k Yen, 15 spins, and 1 Crystal essence
  • ENTDISTRICTUPD2: Reset race potion and 5 fate spins
  • ENTDISTRICTWHEN?: 25 Normal spins, Reset Breathing/Bda Potion, and Reset Race Potion
  • sorry4bugs!: 10x Fate rerolls
  • isbeastbreathingreal: 1x Reset breathing or Art potion
  • 2weekupdate: 10x Mystery ores
  • sorry4bugs

What Are Weak Legacy 2 Codes and Why They Matter

In Roblox games, promo codes are developer-issued rewards used to support players and celebrate updates or milestones. In Weak Legacy 2, they matter more than usual because clans, breathing styles, and demon arts are all luck-based.

Codes let you reroll builds, fix bad RNG, and test different playstyles without restarting or grinding for hours. For new and mid-game players, they significantly reduce friction and make progression smoother.

How to Redeem Weak Legacy 2 Codes

Redeeming codes works the same across PC and mobile and only takes a few seconds.

  1. Launch Weak Legacy 2 on Roblox.
  2. Press M to open the menu.
  3. Locate the Code input section.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Press Enter or Redeem to claim the reward.

Weak Legacy 2 Codes Not Working? Common Fixes

If a code fails, it’s usually due to one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired or was disabled
  • The code was typed incorrectly or with wrong capitalization
  • The server hasn’t refreshed after an update
  • The code was entered in the wrong menu

To fix this, try joining a new server, restarting Roblox, or logging out and back in before redeeming again.

Best Practices for Using Weak Legacy 2 Codes

Use codes deliberately. Redeem them as soon as they release, but avoid spending rerolls immediately unless you understand the current meta.

Resets are best used after testing builds in combat. This approach is especially effective for new and mid-game players who want flexibility without losing progress.

When to Spend Rerolls and Resets

Early game is best for experimenting and learning mechanics. Mid game is where optimization matters most. Late game focuses on refining and min-maxing a strong build.

Avoid impulsive rerolling early, as it often leads to wasted rewards.

Boost Timing: Using Codes with Events and Play Sessions

Redeem codes before long grinding sessions so rewards are used efficiently. Codes pair well with update weekends and major events.

Avoid redeeming codes right before logging off, since most rewards are meant to be used immediately.

Where to Find New Weak Legacy 2 Codes Fast

New codes are usually announced through official channels during updates or milestones.

  • Weak Games official Discord server
  • Roblox game page description
  • Developer YouTube uploads and social posts
  • Update logs and announcement posts

Conclusion

Weak Legacy 2 codes are a reliable way to progress faster, correct bad RNG, and experiment with builds without grinding or spending Robux.

Redeem codes quickly, enter them accurately, and check back often for updates. If you find a new working code, sharing it helps the entire community stay ahead.

FAQs

How do I redeem codes on mobile?

Open the in-game menu and enter the code in the Code section, just like on PC.

Why does my code say invalid?

The code is likely expired, typed incorrectly, or used in an outdated server.

Can codes be used more than once?

No. Each code can only be redeemed once per account.

Do codes work in private servers?

Yes. Some codes only function in new or private servers.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Dueling Grounds Codes on October 01, 2026

Dueling Grounds is a fast‑paced Roblox PvP game where every duel tests your timing, skill, and weapon choice. While you begin with a basic katana, unlocking better weapons and cosmetics requires Coins and Gems.

Dueling Grounds codes help speed up this process by giving players free in‑game currency, making progression faster and less grind‑heavy. In this guide, you’ll find what Dueling Grounds codes are, the currently active codes, how to redeem them, and where to find new ones safely.

All Active Dueling Grounds Codes

  • GemsUpdate: 1000 Coins and 100 Gems (NEW)
  • Oathbreaker: 500x Coins, 100x Gems
  • InnovationAwards: 1,250x Coins, 100x Gems

Expired Dueling Grounds Codes

CHRISTMASUPDATE2026, CREATORSHOWDOWN, DELAYINGGROUNDS, DELAYINGGROUNDS2, FIRSTSPECIALCODE, FLAMINGKATANA, GAUNTLETSUPDATE, HAPPYNEWYEAR, MIDSEASONUPDATE, ONEMILLIONFAVORITES, PEAKGROUNDS, SEASONONEBEGINS, WARHAMMERBUFF2026, WARHAMMERGROUNDS, WINGTHEGOAT

What Are Dueling Grounds Codes?

Dueling Grounds codes are free promotional codes released by the game’s developers. When redeemed, they reward players with Coins and Gems, the two main currencies used to unlock weapons, upgrades, and cosmetic items.

Using these codes helps players progress faster, experiment with new weapons like Dual Daggers or the Naginata, and stay competitive without spending real money.

How to Redeem Dueling Grounds Codes

Redeeming codes in Dueling Grounds is quick and simple:

  1. Launch Dueling Grounds on Roblox.
  2. Skip or complete the tutorial.
  3. Click the green star icon on the left side of the screen.
  4. Enter the code in the Special Codes option.
  5. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

Codes are not case‑sensitive, but avoid extra spaces when entering them.

Looking for more Roblox freebies? Explore Project Egoist codes, Parkour Champions codes, and Anime Crusaders codes next.

Benefits of Using Dueling Grounds Codes

Dueling Grounds codes provide free Coins and Gems that reduce grinding and speed up progression. They allow players to unlock stronger weapons sooner, try different playstyles, and improve their chances in one‑on‑one duels.

For new players, codes make the early game more forgiving. For experienced players, they offer steady bonuses that support long‑term progression.

Trusted Sources for Dueling Grounds Codes

To find active and verified codes, rely on these sources:

  • Official Dueling Grounds Discord server
  • Official Roblox group and developer social channels

Alternatively, you can also just bookmark this page and check back; we keep updating this page with new codes from developers.

FAQs

Are Dueling Grounds Codes free?

Yes. All Dueling Grounds codes are completely free and do not require real‑money purchases.

How often are new Dueling Grounds Codes released?

New codes are released frequently, usually during updates, milestones, or special events.

Can I use expired Dueling Grounds Codes?

No. Expired codes cannot be redeemed, and each code can only be used once per Roblox account.

title.rendered: Plants Tower Defense Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Plants Tower Defense Codes on October 01, 2026

The zombies are marching, and your garden needs help now. Plants Tower Defense codes are limited-time gifts that can change your survival story in seconds. These small lines of text give you free Coins and Gems so you can unlock stronger plants, upgrade your defenses, and push back waves that feel impossible at first. Without them, progress can feel slow and grinding. With them, the game suddenly becomes exciting and full of possibilities.

This guide brings everything you need in one place. You will find the working Plants Tower Defense codes updated regularly, a list of expired codes so you do not waste time, a clear step-by-step redemption guide, fixes for common errors, and smart tips to catch new codes the moment they drop.

All Working Plants Tower Defense Codes

  • gem: Get 20 gems for free
  • newyear: Get 1,126 coins for free
  • primitive: Get 300 coins for free
  • ZL: 50 gems
  • sorryfordelay: 150 gems

These rewards may look small, but they help you open plant packs faster, upgrade rare units, and survive harder modes. Every coin counts when zombies start running faster and hitting harder.

Looking for more Roblox freebies? Don’t miss our regularly updated guides on BLR Legacy codes, Anime Eternal codes, and Hunty Zombie codes to claim free rewards, boosts, and in-game items before they expire. These code lists are refreshed often, so it’s worth checking them alongside this guide to stay ahead in every game.

Expired Plants Tower Defense Codes

0326

How to Redeem Plants Tower Defense Codes

Redeeming codes is simple and takes less than a minute. Follow these steps calmly.

  1. Open Roblox and launch Plants Tower Defense.
  2. Click the Shop button at the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down until you see the code text box.
  4. Type or paste a working code.
  5. Press Enter and enjoy your free reward.

If you did it correctly, the coins or gems will appear instantly in your account.

Where to Find New Plants Tower Defense Codes Fast

The fastest codes usually appear in a few official places.

  • Eyes Team Discord server after updates and milestones
  • Plants Tower Defense Team Roblox group announcements
  • Developer YouTube channels like FeliRBX
  • Official social pages and community posts

You can chase codes yourself, but an easier way is to bookmark this guide and check back often. We collect them from every reliable source, so you do not have to hunt around.

Plants Tower Defense Codes Not Working? 

Sometimes a code refuses to work even when it looks correct. Do not panic. There are a few common reasons.

  • You might be on an old server. Leave the game and join again.
  • A single wrong letter can break a code. Copy and paste instead.
  • The code may have expired after an update.
  • Internet connection might need a quick refresh.

If nothing helps, the code is probably gone for good.

What Are Plants Tower Defense Codes and What Do They Give

These codes are gifts from the developers to keep the community excited. Most of them give Coins and Gems.

  • Coins help you buy basic plant packs and upgrades
  • Gems unlock stronger and special plants
  • Rewards reduce hours of grinding

Think of codes as a shortcut that saves time and makes the game more fun.

Final Words: Redeem Plants Tower Defense Codes Before They Expire

Redeeming codes early is one of the smartest moves in Plants Tower Defense. A few free gems today can mean surviving an extra wave tomorrow. Bookmark this page and check it whenever the game updates so you never miss fresh rewards.

If you discover a new code or face any problem, drop a comment and share it with other players. Codes change fast, and timing matters more than anything.

FAQs

How often do new Plants Tower Defense codes come out?

New codes usually appear during game updates, milestones, or special events. Sometimes they drop weekly, sometimes only during big patches.

Why does my code say invalid?

The code may be expired, typed incorrectly, or you could be on an outdated server. Rejoin the game and try again.

Are Plants Tower Defense codes safe to use?

Yes. Codes are official rewards from the developers and completely safe.

What if I redeemed a code but did not get the reward?

Restart the game and check your balance again. If it still does not show, the code may have expired right before you used it.

In case you missed

  • Roblox Control Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes
  • My Dragon Island Codes
  • Waste Time Codes

title.rendered: Anime Ascendants Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Ascendants Codes on October 20, 2026.

Anime Ascendants is a tower defense game on Roblox where you build a team of anime heroes and protect the multiverse from chaos. Codes give you free Gems and Magic Tokens, which makes it easier to unlock powerful units early in the game.

All Working Anime Ascendants Codes

  • 4thFixed: 10,000 Gems and 50 Trait Rerolls (NEW)
  • Happy4th: 15,000 Gems and 150 Trait Rerolls (NEW)

  • SuperDelay!: 500 Magic Tokens 30,000 Grief Seeds 250 Stat Cubes 1 Super Lucky Potion
  • AscIsBack!: 125 Magic Tokens 25,000 Gems 100 Perfect Stat Cubes 5 Hollow Skin Capsules
  • GetBetterSuper: 75 Magic Tokens 50 Stat Cubes 1 Lucky Potion

How to Redeem Codes in Anime Ascendants

Redeeming codes is simple and takes less than a minute.

  1. Open Roblox player and launch Anime Ascendants.
  2. Click the Codes button near the bottom right.
  3. Type any active code into the text box.
  4. Press Redeem to collect your rewards.

Why Codes Matter in Anime Ascendants

You can get a lot of Gems and Magic Tokens by playing the game, but tower defense games need strong units fast. Codes help you summon high-tier characters without grinding for hours.

When you start the game, having a few powerful units makes progress smoother and lets you enjoy the story and challenges.

How to Get More Anime Ascendants Codes

Developers release codes during updates, events, and milestones, such as likes or visits. The fastest ways to find new codes are:

  • Check the Anime Ascendants Discord
  • Follow Special Anime Defense on YouTube
  • Watch for new codes during patch releases
  • Bookmark this page for quick updates

Why Your Anime Ascendants Codes Might Not Work

If a code is not working, try these fixes. It usually fails because the server has not refreshed yet or the code has expired.

  • Restart the game to load the latest server data
  • Join a private server and redeem the code again
  • Copy and paste the code to avoid typing mistakes
  • Check your spelling because codes are case sensitive
  • Redeem on a fresh session after updates go live
  • Try again after a short wait if servers are busy
  • Check if the code expired because old codes stop working fast

You may like to read: Best short anime to watch instead of One Piece

What is Anime Ascendants?

Anime Ascendants is a Roblox tower defense game inspired by shows like Naruto, Bleach, Hunter x Hunter, and Jujutsu Kaisen. You collect units, evolve them, and create team strategies to beat waves of enemies. Story Mode gives context to each world, while challenges test your lineup and skills.

  • Project Blue Lock Codes

  • Midnight Racing Tokyo Codes

title.rendered: Roblox Deep Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Roblox Deep Codes on October 01, 2026

There’s something strangely calming about diving into the deep ocean until your oxygen runs out and your pockets are empty. Deep on Roblox captures that feeling perfectly. You explore the ocean floor, collect hidden treasure, and slowly upgrade your scuba gear to reach even darker depths. But let’s be honest: the early grind can feel slow. That’s where Deep codes step in and make a real difference.

These codes give you free Cash, the main in-game currency, so you can skip hours of grinding and focus on what actually matters: exploring deeper waters, finding rarer treasure, and upgrading your gear faster.

What Are Deep Codes and Why Do They Matter?

Deep codes are special redeemable rewards released by the game’s developers. When you use a code, you instantly receive Cash that can be spent on essential upgrades like oxygen tanks, flippers, and vision goggles. For new players, this can completely change the early-game experience. For returning players, it’s an easy boost that helps you keep progressing without repeating the same dives.

Cash earned from codes works exactly like earned Cash in-game, meaning you can use it freely with no restrictions. Some assets generate passive income, making these early boosts even more valuable.

All Active Deep Codes

  • March2026: Free rewards
  • 17MilVisits: Free rewards
  • HappyValentines: Free rewards
  • February2026: Free rewards
  • 16MilVisits: Free rewards
  • PotionPush: 1k cash
  • 12MilVisits: 1k cash
  • 13MilVisits: 1k cash
  • 200kMembers: 1k cash
  • NewMap2026: 1k cash
  • Sub2AkashMakesBeats: 2.5k cash
  • January2026: 1k cash
  • HappyNewYears: 2.5k cash
  • 150kMembers: 1k cash

The following codes are currently working and reward free Cash. Codes are case-sensitive, so enter them exactly as shown.

Using all active codes together can give you a strong starting balance, enough to buy better oxygen tanks and dive far deeper than a new player normally could.

Expired Deep Codes

100KMEMBERS, 10MILVISITS, 11MILVISITS, 15MILVISITS, 4MILVISITS, 7MILVISITS, 8MILVISITS, 9MILVISITS, DECEMBER2025, HAPPYHOLIDAYS

How to Redeem Deep Codes

Redeeming codes in Deep is quick and simple, even if you’re brand new to Roblox.

  1. Launch Deep on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop icon on the left side of your screen.
  3. Scroll down until you find the Codes section.
  4. Copy and paste an active code into the text box.
  5. Press Redeem or Claim to receive your reward instantly.

If the code is valid, the Cash will be added to your account right away.

Why a Code Might Not Work

If a code fails, don’t panic; it’s usually for one of these simple reasons:

  • The code has expired
  • There’s a typo or extra space
  • The code was already redeemed
  • The game servers are refreshing after an update

To avoid errors, always copy and paste code directly and double-check capitalization.

Where to Find New Deep Codes

New codes are usually released during milestones, updates, or special events. The best places to stay updated are:

  • The official Deep Discord server.
  • Developer YouTube channel is linked to the game.
  • Or even the official Roblox community of the game.

Bookmark this page, and we’ll keep it updated with new Deep codes as soon as they’re announced by the developers.

Final Thoughts

Deep is all about patience, progression, and discovery. But patience doesn’t mean suffering through slow upgrades. With the latest Deep codes, you can gear up faster, dive deeper sooner, and enjoy the game the way it’s meant to be played, focused on exploration, not grinding.

If you love ocean exploration games and the thrill of uncovering rare treasure, these codes are your shortcut to the deep unknown. Use them while they’re active, and keep diving.

In case you missed

  • Roblox You VS Homer Codes
  • Roblox Knockout Codes
  • Roblox Horse Life Codes
  • Solo Hunters Codes
  • Roblox Control Codes

title.rendered: Roblox Horse Life Codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Horse Life Codes on October 24, 2026

Training the perfect horse in Roblox’s Horse Life is rewarding, but it is not always quick. You capture horses, breed them, raise foals, improve stats, and gather materials to make them stronger and faster. The grind is real. That is exactly where Horse Life codes help. They give you free food, dyes, tools, and event items that make progression smoother without spending hours farming.

Below, you will find every currently working Horse Life code, what they reward, how to redeem them properly, and why some codes may not work.

All Working Horse Life Codes

Currently, there are no active codes available. Developers release new codes during events and updates, so check back soon!

Redeem each code only once per account.

If you are hunting for more Roblox freebies, do not miss our updated Solo Hunters codes, You VS Homer codes, and My Dragon Island codes guides to grab extra rewards, boosts, and event items across your favorite games.

Expired Horse Life Codes

100KTWITTER, APRILFOOLS, APRILFOOLY, APRILFOOLZ, ENJOYYOURWEEKEND, HALLOWEENQNA3, HAPPYLUNARNEWYEAR, HAPPYPLUSHRELEASE, HAPPYPRIDE25, LATETHANKSGIVING, MANYMINIPOTIONS, MONTHLYMISSION, NEWBEGINNINGS, REDVELVET, SPOOKYCHESTS, URANIUM, VALENTINEGIFT, VEGGIECAPSULE, WINTERUPDATE

How to Redeem Horse Life Codes

Before you redeem any code, make sure you have completed the game’s tutorial. The code menu only becomes available once you are in normal gameplay.

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Open Roblox and launch Horse Life.
  2. Once you spawn in the game world, find the large Login Rewards gift box.
  3. Walk up to the gift and interact with it. On PC, press E. On mobile, tap it.
  4. When the Login Rewards window opens, click the Codes tab.
  5. Type or paste a working code exactly as shown.
  6. Click Redeem and wait for confirmation.

Enter one code at a time and repeat the process for the rest.

What Do Horse Life Codes Give You?

Horse Life codes are tied to updates, seasonal events, community milestones, and Q&A events from the developers at Sonar Studios. They usually unlock one-use reward bundles that support both progression and customization.

Rewards generally fall into these categories:

  • Food items like Green Apples and Mystic Food are used for caring and training horses
  • Crafting resources, such as materials that help create consumables
  • Capture tools like Master Lassos to secure new horses
  • Breeding items, including Instant Foal Potion,s that skip wait times
  • Cosmetics such as plush accessories, Pride flags, themed tails, and seasonal dyes
  • Progression currency like Stars and Mints

For example, the Uranium code gives five Green Apples. These apples can be used in crafting recipes like Lush Jam, which reduces ability cooldowns. Small items like this can quietly improve performance over time.

Some codes focus purely on cosmetics, while others provide items that directly support training, capturing, or breeding. It depends on the event they are tied to.

Why Your Horse Life Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, do not panic. Most issues are simple.

  • The code has expired. Many codes are tied to limited-time events.
  • There is a spelling mistake. Codes are case sensitive. Even one wrong letter will break it.
  • You already redeemed it. Each code works once per account.
  • Your client is outdated. Restart Roblox and rejoin the game.

If everything looks correct, leave the server and join again. Sometimes the game needs a quick refresh after updates.

What Is Horse Life About?

Horse Life is an open-world Roblox experience focused on capturing, breeding, and training horses. You explore the world, tame new horses, improve their stats, and breed foals to create stronger bloodlines. There are also cosmetic customization options with dyes, accessories, plush items, and themed event rewards.

The game includes multiplayer features, so you can ride alongside friends and explore together. While it has tycoon-like elements, it plays more like a simulation where patience and smart resource management matter.

Where to Get New Horse Life Codes

New codes usually appear during seasonal events like Valentine’s Day, Halloween, Lunar New Year, Pride celebrations, or major updates. The official Discord server from the developers is the primary source for announcements.

However, Discord channels move fast, and updates can easily get buried. The simplest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page. We monitor new updates closely and add fresh Horse Life codes here as soon as they go live, while also moving expired ones out of the working list so you do not waste time testing old codes.

That is everything you need to know about Horse Life codes right now. Redeem them, strengthen your horses, and enjoy the ride.
