title.rendered: Roblox Music Codes (June 2026): Best Song IDs

content.rendered:
Roblox Music Codes let you play specific audio tracks in supported Roblox experiences using a numeric Song ID. Whether you want background music while building, hype tracks during battles, or short meme sounds for reactions, these codes give you direct control over in-game audio.

This guide explains how Roblox Music Codes work, why some stop working, how to use them correctly, and provides categorized tables of working Song IDs for 2026. Each section is structured so you can quickly scan, understand, and use the information without confusion.

What Are Roblox Music Codes?

Roblox Music Codes, also called Song IDs, are numeric asset IDs linked to audio files uploaded to Roblox. When entered into a supported game’s Boombox or Radio system, the platform retrieves that audio asset and plays it inside the experience. Roblox does not allow universal music playback across all games. The developer must enable audio playback through either a Boombox system or a Radio Game Pass.

Before using codes, it is important to understand the platform rules that affect them:

  • Since June 18, 2018, Roblox automatically rejects non-licensed music uploads.
  • Many popular songs are shortened clips to reduce copyright risk.
  • Full-length uploads are rare and more likely to be removed.
  • A working Music ID today may stop working tomorrow due to moderation or asset deletion.

Understanding these limitations explains why some codes disappear and why remixes or independent uploads are more common than original studio tracks.

Trending Roblox Music Codes

The table below lists commonly used and stable Song IDs across different genres. Use the Category column to quickly identify the type of track you want.

Lo-Fi, Classical & Background Music

If you prefer relaxed gameplay, roleplay immersion, or focus music while building, the tracks below are commonly used for calmer environments.

Full-Length Roblox Music Codes (Rare Finds)

Most Roblox uploads are short clips. Full-length tracks are harder to maintain because longer uploads face stricter moderation. The codes below have historically played beyond short hook segments.

Availability can change at any time due to moderation.

Meme & Sound Effect Codes

If you are looking for quick reactions, elimination sounds, or comedic timing, these short audio clips are commonly used in competitive or casual games.

How to Use Roblox Music Codes

Music Codes only function inside experiences that support audio playback. Before entering a Song ID, confirm the game allows Boombox or Radio features.

Requirements Before Using a Song ID

To activate custom audio, you typically need one of the following systems enabled by the developer:

  • Boombox gear item that opens a Music ID input field.
  • Radio Game Pass that unlocks custom audio (often 100–200 Robux depending on the game).

If the experience does not support either system, Music Codes will not work.

Testing Music Codes for Free

Before spending Robux, you can verify whether a Song ID is active. The experience Catalog Heaven allows temporary Boombox usage for testing.

Steps:

  1. Launch Catalog Heaven on Roblox.
  2. Click the Catalog button at the top center.
  3. Search for Golden Super Fly Boombox.
  4. Equip it (press “1” on PC or tap on mobile).
  5. Click the Boombox your character is holding.
  6. Paste the Music Code into the input box.
  7. Press Play.

If the audio plays, the asset is active. If nothing happens, the code may have been removed, restricted, or replaced.

Using Song IDs in Other Games

Once inside a supported experience, the process is similar:

  1. Purchase or equip the Boombox or Radio feature.
  2. Open the audio interface.
  3. Paste the Music ID.
  4. Press Play.

Always copy and paste the code. Even one incorrect digit will cause the ID to fail.

Why Roblox Music Codes Stop Working

Music IDs commonly fail due to platform moderation or technical restrictions. The most frequent causes include:

  • The audio asset was removed due to copyright enforcement.
  • The uploader deleted or replaced the file.
  • The game disabled external audio playback.
  • The code was entered incorrectly.

Roblox continuously audits audio assets, which is why remixes and independent uploads are generally more stable than full commercial tracks.

How to Fix a Non-Working Music Code

If a Song ID does not play, use the troubleshooting steps below to isolate the issue:

  1. Copy and paste the code instead of typing it manually.
  2. Restart Roblox to refresh assets.
  3. Check your internet connection.
  4. Search for an alternative upload of the same song.

If none of these steps resolve the issue, the asset has likely been permanently removed.

Roblox Music IDs vs Kill Sounds: What’s the Difference?

Not all audio codes serve the same purpose. Music IDs are longer tracks used for background atmosphere or roleplay. Kill sounds are 1–3 second audio clips triggered by specific game events. Both use numeric asset IDs but are designed for different gameplay scenarios.

Signing off

Roblox Music Codes are audio asset IDs that only work in supported experiences. They require a Boombox or Radio feature enabled by the developer. Copyright enforcement frequently removes tracks. Full-length songs are rare and less stable. Always copy and paste codes for accuracy. Understanding how the system works helps you quickly identify working audio and avoid common errors.

title.rendered: How to Block and Unblock Someone on Instagram

content.rendered:
Instagram is a great place to share photos, watch stories, and stay connected. However, there are times when you may not want certain people to view your profile or contact you. Whether it is unwanted messages, spam, or simply a need for personal space, Instagram gives you tools to control who can interact with you.

In this guide, you’ll learn exactly how to block and unblock someone on Instagram, what happens when you do, and how to manage your privacy in a simple, stress-free way.

What Happens When You Block Someone on Instagram?

When you block someone on Instagram, several things happen instantly.

  • Once blocked, they can’t search for your account or see your posts or stories, even if they are logged out. To them, it’s almost like your account doesn’t exist.
  • Their likes and comments will disappear from your posts. However, they can still see your likes and comments on public posts or accounts they follow.
  • They cannot send new messages, and you cannot message them either. Blocking does not automatically delete chat history on your side. Your previous conversation in DMs stays in your inbox.
  • If you’re in a group chat with a blocked user, you can choose to stay or leave. If you stay, both you and the blocked person will be able to view each other’s messages in the group.
  • They can’t tag or mention you anymore. Existing tags may remain unless you remove them manually.
  • If you create a room after blocking someone, they won’t be able to join it.

Instagram does not send a notification when you block someone. Also, Instagram may block their current and future accounts linked to the same person.

How to Block Someone on Instagram (iPhone and Android)

You can block someone in several ways on both iPhone and Android. Here are four methods to block a user on Instagram without them knowing.

From Someone’s Profile

This is the most common method.

  1. Open Instagram and tap the search button to find the person.
  2. Tap the username to visit their profile.
  3. Tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner.
  4. Select Block and confirm your choice by tapping Block on the pop-up. You can also choose Block and report if the account is spamming.

Via Direct Messages (DM)

You can also block someone directly from your chat.

  1. Open your Instagram inbox from the bottom menu.
  2. Tap the chat of that person.
  3. Tap their name at the top.
  4. Select Options and choose Block.
  5. Tap Block again to confirm.

From a Comment on Your Post

If someone leaves an unwanted comment, you can block them immediately.

  1. Tap your profile photo in the bottom menu and open a post.
  2. Go to the comment section.
  3. Press and hold the comment of the person you want to block.
  4. Select Block from the dropdown menu and confirm.

Must read: Instagram Restrict vs. Block: Which should you choose?

How to Unblock Someone on Instagram

Changed your mind? Here’s how to reverse it on iPhone and Android.

From the Blocked Accounts List

  1. Go to your profile.
  2. Tap the menu (☰) and open Settings.
  3. Scroll down and select Blocked.
  4. You’ll see your list of blocked accounts. Find the account you want to unblock.
  5. Tap Unblock beside the account.
  6. Confirm your choice.

Directly From Their Profile

If you remember their username and can find their profile:

  1. Tap the search button in the bottom menu bar.
  2. Open the profile.
  3. Tap the Unblock button under their bio.
  4. Tap Unblock again in the dialog box to confirm.

What Happens After You Unblock Someone on Instagram?

When you unblock someone, most restrictions are lifted. However, there are a few important details to keep in mind.

  • Instagram does not notify users when you unblock them.
  • Your old chat thread remains if it wasn’t deleted. However, any messages they tried to send while blocked will not be delivered.
  • You must manually follow each other again. If your account is private, they’ll need to send a follow request.
  • Instagram may require you to wait up to 48 hours before blocking the same person again.

Block vs Restrict vs Mute on Instagram: Key Differences Explained

Blocking isn’t always necessary. Instagram offers softer options to improve your experience.

Here’s a simple comparison:

When to Use Each Option

  • Block: For harassment, stalking, or spam.
  • Restrict: For acquaintances you want to limit quietly.
  • Mute: For friends who post too often.

If you’re dealing with serious harassment, blocking is usually the safest option. You can also limit comments to followers and filter offensive comments automatically.

Make Your Instagram Experience Better by Blocking

Blocking someone on Instagram is simple and completely private. It’s designed to help you feel safe and in control of your online space. There are also softer alternatives like mute and restrict if blocking feels too extreme.

Use the Block feature wisely. Social media should support your well-being, not harm it.

FAQs

Can someone know if I have blocked them on Instagram?

Instagram does not send a notification, but they may realize it if they can’t find your profile.

Can you see who blocked you on Instagram?

Instagram does not provide a list of users who have blocked you.

What happens if I block someone who follows me?

They will automatically be removed as a follower.

Can a blocked person still see my public profile?

Not while logged into the blocked account.

Does blocking someone delete DMs on both sides?

No. Messages remain unless they are manually deleted.

Can you block someone on Instagram if they have already blocked you?

Yes. You can still block them if you find their profile or access past messages.

title.rendered: Apple Watch Not Responding? 8 Fixes That Actually Work

content.rendered:
Apple Watch is not just another smartwatch. It delivers a premium experience backed by advanced health tracking, deep iPhone integration, and powerful everyday features, all at a premium price. So when it suddenly becomes unresponsive, the frustration is completely understandable. A frozen screen or delayed response can interrupt workouts, notifications, and essential tasks, making the issue feel more serious than it often is.

If you are dealing with a similar issue, you’re at the right place. This post details how to fix an unresponsive Apple Watch.

Table of Contents
  • Why Your Apple Watch Becomes Unresponsive
  • 1. Check for Touchscreen Issues First
  • 2. Force Restart Your Apple Watch
  • 3. Charge Your Apple Watch
  • 4. Check for Overheating
  • 5. Free Up Storage Space
  • 6. Update to the Latest watchOS Version
  • 7. Unpair and Re-Pair Your Apple Watch
  • 8. Contact Apple Support
  • Back in Action…

Why Your Apple Watch Becomes Unresponsive

To save time and avoid unnecessary troubleshooting, it helps to understand the common factors that can cause your Apple Watch to stop responding. Identifying the possible reason behind the issue can make it easier to apply the right fix quickly:

  • Dirty or wet screen preventing touch detection
  • Fingers covered with moisture, lotion, or gloves
  • Incompatible or thick screen protectors
  • Temporary watchOS bugs or crashes
  • Failed or incomplete software updates
  • Low battery or charging problems
  • Overheating protection
  • Low storage space
  • Sync conflicts between iPhone and Apple Watch

1. Check for Touchscreen Issues First

Before moving on to technical troubleshooting, make sure none of the following factors are interfering with the Apple Watch’s touch responsiveness:

  • Your fingers are dirty or covered: If you are wearing gloves or your fingers are covered with moisture, oil, or any residue, your Apple Watch may not recognize touch input properly. Make sure your fingers are clean and uncovered before trying again.
  • The Apple Watch screen is dirty: An oily, dirty, or wet display can affect touch responsiveness. Gently clean the screen using a soft, lint-free cloth.
  • A screen protector is affecting use: A poorly fitted or thick screen protector can interfere with touch sensitivity. Reapply the protector correctly, or temporarily remove it to see if responsiveness improves.
  • Physical damage to the display: Cracks, deep scratches, or impact damage can affect touch detection and make the screen appear unresponsive. If you notice visible damage, the issue may require professional repair or screen replacement.

2. Force Restart Your Apple Watch

In most cases, an Apple Watch becomes unresponsive due to temporary software bugs or system glitches running in the background. A force restart refreshes watchOS by shutting down all active processes and reloading the system, often restoring normal responsiveness within seconds. Here’s how:

  1. Press and hold the Digital Crown and Side button together.
  2. Keep holding for about 10 to 15 seconds.
  3. Release when the Apple logo appears.
  4. Once it does, the watch will reboot automatically.

3. Charge Your Apple Watch

If you have not used your Apple Watch for several days, the battery may have drained completely, making the device appear unresponsive. In such cases, the screen may remain black, and the watch may not react to button presses immediately. To fix this:

  1. Place your Apple Watch on its magnetic charger.
  2. Wait for at least 15 to 20 minutes.
  3. Once enough power is restored, the charging icon or Apple logo should appear, indicating that the device is turning back on.

However, if nothing happens, try using a different charger, as the issue may be with the charging cable or adapter rather than the Apple Watch itself.

4. Check for Overheating

When you use your Apple Watch in extreme conditions or expose it to direct sunlight for an extended period, it may temporarily stop responding if it becomes too warm. This is a built-in safety feature designed to protect the internal components from overheating.

In such a case, remove the watch from your wrist and let it cool for a few minutes. Avoid charging or exposing it to direct sunlight during this time. Once the temperature returns to normal, the watch should function properly again.

5. Free Up Storage Space

Like any other computing device, your Apple Watch can become slow and sluggish when storage space runs low, making it unresponsive at times.

To check available storage on your Apple Watch:

  1. Open the Watch app and tap General.
  2. Now, scroll down and tap Storage.
  3. Here, you will see the available storage space along with a breakdown of how much storage each app is using.

If available storage is low, removing unused apps, music, podcasts, or photos will free up space and improve performance.

6. Update to the Latest watchOS Version

Outdated software can sometimes cause freezing or responsiveness issues. Apple regularly releases watchOS updates that include bug fixes and performance improvements. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Watch app and tap General.
  2. Here, tap Software Update.
  3. Install any available update.

7. Unpair and Re-Pair Your Apple Watch

If none of the previous solutions work, unpairing and re-pairing the Apple Watch can resolve deeper software conflicts. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Watch app → All Watches.
  2. Tap the i button next to your Apple Watch.
  3. Tap Unpair Apple Watch and follow the on-screen instructions.
  4. After the process completes, pair the watch again.

8. Contact Apple Support

If you’ve already tried everything and the issue persists, the problem may be hardware-related. Problems such as a faulty display, damaged buttons, or a failed battery require professional inspection.

In this case, contact Apple Support or visit an Apple Authorized Service Provider for further assistance.

Back in Action…

An unresponsive Apple Watch can be concerning at first, but in most cases, the issue can be resolved with simple troubleshooting steps, provided there is no physical damage. Problems such as temporary software glitches, low battery, overheating, or storage limitations are common and can usually be fixed within minutes.

However, if the issue continues even after a full reset, professional support is the safest next step to ensure your Apple Watch functions reliably again.

Did any of these solutions help fix your Apple Watch? Let us know in the comments and share your experience with other readers.

title.rendered: Best Mac Apps You Should Install in 2026

content.rendered:
Signing in to your Apple Account may get your Mac ready for use, yet relying only on built-in apps often leaves small yet noticeable workflow gaps. While your Mac feels complete out of the box, a few thoughtfully chosen apps can make everyday tasks faster, simpler, and more efficient. From launching apps more conveniently to improving file management and screen capture, the right tools help turn a standard Mac setup into a workspace that truly fits your needs.

However, with so many apps available, choosing the right ones can be overwhelming. To save you time, I’ve conducted the research and compiled this list. Read on to discover the must-have Mac apps worth installing.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Affinity by Canva
  • 2. CleanShot X
  • 3. LaunchMe – Launchpad Alternative
  • 4. ChatGPT Atlas Browser
  • 5. LocalSend
  • 6. Folder Quick Look
  • 7. Unsplash Wallpapers
  • Time to Upgrade Your Mac Experience…

1. Affinity by Canva

If you need powerful creative software on your Mac but don’t want to pay those hefty subscription fees, Affinity by Canva is what you need. It’s a practical alternative that provides professional design tools at zero cost while continually adding modern capabilities.

The suite includes a range of creative workflows, including graphic design, photo editing, and page layout. Together, they handle everything from editing blog images to creating social media graphics and designing detailed documents and marketing materials.

Alongside its advanced editing tools, Affinity now also includes Canva-powered features such as AI background removal, quick image enhancements, and faster design adjustments, making common tasks easier without changing the traditional editing workflow users are familiar with.

Key highlights

  • Includes Photo, Designer, and Publisher apps
  • Completely free to use
  • Professional editing and design tools
  • Built-in AI-powered enhancements for faster edits
  • Optimized for Apple silicon Macs

Price: Free

Download

2. CleanShot X

Your Mac’s built-in screenshot tool does almost everything it’s designed for, yet it still misses several features that power users and content creators often need. CleanShot X fills those gaps by turning screenshots and screen recordings into a complete workflow.

The app lets you capture scrolling screenshots, instantly annotate images, blur sensitive information, and share files quickly without interrupting your work. The floating preview window also makes it easy to edit or discard captures before they clutter your desktop.

For anyone who frequently creates tutorials, presentations, or visual guides, CleanShot X makes capturing and sharing content noticeably faster and more polished.

Key highlights

  • Scrolling screenshots and advanced captures
  • Instant annotations and blur tools
  • Clean screen recording interface
  • Floating preview window for quick edits
  • Fast sharing via links or export options

Price: $8/month or $29/year

Download

3. LaunchMe – Launchpad Alternative

Starting with macOS Tahoe, Apple moved away from Launchpad on Mac, leaving users without a simple, visual way to access their apps. While Spotlight search works well, it does not fully replace the quick app-drawer experience many Mac users were accustomed to.

LaunchMe fills that gap by bringing back a dedicated launcher designed for speed and simplicity. It restores the convenience of launching apps visually while adding modern productivity features that go beyond what Launchpad ever offered.

You can instantly access apps, files, and folders from a clean interface using shortcuts, gestures, or Hot Corners, making navigation feel faster and more intuitive.

Key highlights

  • Launchpad-style app launcher for modern macOS
  • Quick access using shortcuts, gestures, or Hot Corners
  • Built-in clipboard manager and file search
  • Custom app icons or themed icon packs
  • Custom layouts with Light and Dark mode support
  • Built-in widgets include photos, shaped images, text, animations, and GIFs

Price: Free (Pro version available)

Download

4. ChatGPT Atlas Browser

summarize pages, explain information, or refine text without leaving the website you’re viewing.

The browser also includes an agent mode that assists with research and task-based browsing, helping you gather information more efficiently. You can highlight text anywhere on a page and instantly ask ChatGPT to rewrite or simplify it, making everyday browsing and writing workflows faster.

Rest assured, privacy controls remain central to the experience, allowing you to decide what Atlas remembers and how AI interacts with your browsing activity. Combined with familiar browser features like tabs and bookmarks, Atlas feels easy to adopt while adding powerful AI assistance.

Key highlights

  • Built-in ChatGPT sidebar for AI-assisted browsing
  • Summarize, rewrite, and explain content instantly
  • Agent mode for research and task workflows
  • Text assistance directly from highlighted content
  • Customizable privacy controls

Price: Free

Download

5. LocalSend

When it comes to file sharing between Apple devices, nothing beats the convenience of AirDrop. It’s fast, reliable, and deeply integrated into macOS and iOS. However, like many Apple proprietary features, AirDrop remains limited to the Apple ecosystem, which quickly becomes frustrating when you need to send files to Windows PCs or Android devices.

LocalSend solves this limitation by offering a simple, cross-platform alternative that works over your local network. The app allows you to transfer files directly between devices without relying on cloud storage, cables, or account sign-ins. As long as both devices are connected to the same network, you can share files instantly and securely.

And since transfers occur locally between devices, there are no file-size restrictions, uploads, or privacy concerns.

Key highlights

  • Cross-platform file sharing across macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android
  • Works over the local network without internet
  • No account setup or cloud uploads required
  • Fast transfers with no file size limits

Price: Free

Download

6. Folder Quick Look

While macOS’s built-in Quick Look tool lets you instantly preview images and files with a press of the spacebar, it does not work with folders.

Folder Quick Look fixes this long-standing limitation by allowing you to preview folder contents instantly. Instead of opening multiple Finder windows just to check what’s inside, you can quickly glance at files and move on.

This small addition makes a big difference when managing downloads, media libraries, or project folders. Navigation becomes faster, and Finder feels less cluttered during everyday use.

Moreover, like LaunchMe, Folder Quick Look does not feel like a third-party app; once you get the hang of it, it feels like a native macOS feature.

Key highlights

  • Preview folders using Quick Look (Spacebar)
  • Faster navigation without opening Finder windows
  • Reduces desktop and Finder clutter
  • Improves file organization workflow

Price: $3.99

Download

7. Unsplash Wallpapers

When personalizing their Mac, most Mac users begin by changing the wallpaper; however, finding high-quality backgrounds can be surprisingly time-consuming. Unsplash Wallpapers simplifies this by bringing a large collection of professional photography directly to your desktop.

The app automatically updates your wallpaper with curated images from Unsplash, keeping your Mac feeling fresh without manual downloads or constant customization.

Most importantly, the app quietly sits in your Mac’s menu bar, consumes minimal system resources, and integrates naturally with macOS appearance settings.

You can choose from a wide variety of wallpaper themes and how frequently wallpapers change, ensuring your desktop stays visually interesting without becoming distracting.

Key highlights

  • Access to high-resolution Unsplash photography
  • Automatic wallpaper rotation
  • Lightweight background performance
  • Keeps desktop fresh with minimal setup

Price: Free

Download

Time to Upgrade Your Mac Experience…

Once you start using these apps, you’ll wonder how you managed your workflow without them. Together, they simplify everyday tasks and help your Mac feel more efficient and personalized.

Which Mac apps do you install first on a new Mac? Let us know in the comments below.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Begins Global Rollout of Promoted Channels and Status Ads

content.rendered:
WhatsApp has begun rolling out Promoted Channels and Status ads globally, introducing advertising into the app’s Updates tab for the first time as part of Meta’s broader effort to monetize the messaging platform.

In an official announcement shared on X, WhatsApp confirmed that Promoted Channels and ads in Status are now available worldwide, meaning users will gradually see sponsored content inside the Updates tab.

Promoted Channels and ads in Status are available globally now, so you’ll likely start seeing them in the Updates tab if you haven’t yet.

These features help you find businesses and Channels to connect with right in WhatsApp. Your personal messages are end-to-end encrypted and…

— WhatsApp (@WhatsApp) February 26, 2026

The rollout marks a major shift for WhatsApp, which historically avoided advertising since its launch.

Ads Limited to the Updates Tab

According to WhatsApp, advertisements will appear only within the Updates tab, which includes Status and Channels, leaving private chats, calls, and group conversations unchanged.

Status ads are displayed between regular Status updates in a full-screen format similar to Stories ads on other Meta platforms. Businesses can use these placements to promote products or services and allow users to initiate conversations directly from the ad experience.

WhatsApp says the personal messaging experience remains private, with end-to-end encryption continuing to protect messages, calls, and shared media.

Users can also control the visibility of advertising in the app. If a promoted post feels intrusive, users can open the three-dot menu to hide the ad or block the advertiser entirely.

Blocking a business prevents its promotional content from appearing again in the Updates tab, while additional ad preferences and interaction controls can be managed through WhatsApp’s settings, giving users direct oversight of their advertising experience.

Promoted Channels Improve Discovery

Alongside Status ads, WhatsApp is introducing Promoted Channels, enabling creators, organizations, and businesses to pay for increased visibility within the Channels directory.

Promoted listings appear highlighted to help users discover new content while clearly indicating paid placement. The feature expands WhatsApp Channels beyond a broadcast tool into a discovery-driven platform similar to creator ecosystems seen on other social apps.

A Strategic Monetization Shift

Advertising inside the Updates tab represents one of WhatsApp’s most significant strategic changes. Meta has long explored ways to generate revenue from WhatsApp without disrupting private communication, ultimately choosing discovery surfaces rather than chat interfaces.

This is why ads are intentionally separated from messaging spaces. It reinforces WhatsApp’s privacy positioning while opening new growth opportunities for businesses and creators.

Gradual Rollout

Since these features are rolling out in phases, availability may vary depending on the region and app version. Users who primarily use WhatsApp for messaging may notice little change beyond occasional sponsored Status updates and promoted channel suggestions.

title.rendered: IDC: iPhone Could Gain Share in 2026 as Memory Shortage Hits Android

content.rendered:
The global smartphone market will contract 12.9 percent in 2026 due to an unprecedented memory chip shortage, with total shipments falling to 1.1 billion units from 1.26 billion in 2025, according to IDC data detailed in a Bloomberg report. The downturn is expected to weigh more heavily on low-cost Android manufacturers, while premium devices such as Apple’s iPhone lineup are projected to remain comparatively resilient.

Memory Shortage Driven by AI Demand

IDC describes the current supply crunch as “a crisis like no other.” Demand for advanced DRAM and NAND memory used in artificial intelligence workloads has absorbed global production capacity, tightening availability across the electronics sector. The shortage is expected to persist well into next year.

Modern smartphones rely heavily on DRAM for multitasking and AI-driven features, and on NAND flash for storage. As component prices rise, manufacturers face higher bill-of-material costs at a time when consumer demand remains price sensitive.

Budget Android Models Face Margin Pressure

IDC expects the memory shortage to impact low-cost Android devices most severely. Many Android brands operate on thin profit margins, particularly in the entry-level and midrange segments. Higher memory prices compress those margins further, making certain models economically unviable.

As a result, IDC anticipates reduced production volumes among budget Android handsets. Fewer models are expected to reach market as manufacturers scale back to protect profitability.

Premium Smartphones Expected to Remain Resilient

IDC indicates that premium handsets, including the bulk of Apple Inc.’s iPhone lineup, are positioned to withstand the disruption more effectively. Higher average selling prices in the premium segment provide greater flexibility to absorb component cost increases.

If lower-cost Android production declines while premium volumes remain comparatively stable, Apple could expand its share of the global smartphone market in 2026, even as overall industry shipments fall.

The forecast does not indicate that Apple will be immune to supply constraints. However, IDC’s data suggests the structural economics of the premium segment offer greater resilience during prolonged component shortages.

content.rendered:
If you’re an Invincible fan, your iPhone lock screen should reflect that. The series has delivered some of the most visually striking moments in animated superhero storytelling, from Mark Grayson’s early days figuring out his powers to the brutal confrontations with Omni-Man and the Viltrumites. That kind of energy deserves a wallpaper that matches it.

We’ve put together a collection of the best Invincible wallpapers in 4K featuring Mark Grayson, Omni-Man, Atom Eve, the Grayson family, and some of the most iconic scenes from the series. Whether you prefer a clean character portrait, a dramatic action shot, or a cosmic space scene, there’s something here for every type of fan. All wallpapers are free to download and sized to fit iPhone displays perfectly.

1. Yellow Poster Style Invincible Wallpaper 

The new adaptive clock in iOS 26 Lock Screen looks like one of a kind. This classic poster-style design with an Invincible logo and bold yellow background is a perfect choice to enjoy this feature.



Download

2. Superhero Team Group Wallpaper 

Invincible stands alongside multiple versions and allies in a dramatic sky setting. A perfect wallpaper for fans who love the larger superhero universe and team dynamics.

Download

3. Invincible in Flying into Sky 

A clean and simple shot of Invincible flying upward against a soft blue sky. Minimal, calm, and perfect for a sleek lock screen look.

Download

4. Invincible Watching Night City 

Invincible, standing confidently above the city at night, cape flowing behind him. The dark sky and glowing city lights create a strong, heroic vibe. 

Download

5. Injured Invincible Portrait 

A close-up of Invincible, bruised but determined. If you like clean interfaces to make your app icons and widgets stand out, download this wallpaper. 

Download

6. Heroic Invincible Flying Through Fire 

An intense action scene of Invincible bursting through flames. Bright fire effects make this one bold, energetic, and eye-catching. 

Download

7. Invincible Flying Above Earth Space 

Invincible soars high above Earth with space in the background. It’s a powerful cosmic-style wallpaper that feels epic and limitless. 

Download

8. Epic Air Fight Wallpaper 

A dramatic mid-air battle scene frozen at the moment of impact. Perfect for fans who love high-speed action and explosive confrontations. 

Download

9. Cosmic Space Hero Wallpaper 

A stunning space-themed shot with Invincible standing heroically under a star-filled sky. Clean, sharp, and visually striking in 4K. 

Download

10. Action Scene Green Background 

An intense combat moment with a bright green backdrop and flying enemies. This makes your iPhone screen dynamic, energetic, and full of motion. 

Download

11. Cosmic Clash

This dynamic Invincible wallpaper captures a brutal battle between Mark Grayson and a formidable opponent. The contrast between Invincible’s vibrant colors and his enemy’s menacing black form will always remind you of the struggle between good and evil.

Download

12. Mark Grayson Invincible wallpaper

This vibrant and eye-catching background for your iPhone offers a unique, stylized take on Mark Grayson. This wallpaper is perfect for fans who want to showcase their love for the series with a touch of artistic flair.

Download

13. Dynamic Duo

Here’s Invincible in his new blue suit and Atom Even in her statement pink. This wallpaper is for anyone who appreciates the heroic and aspirational aspects of Invincible, highlighting the themes of courage, teamwork, and the enduring power of hope.

Download

14. The Graysons Invincible HD wallpaper

Family plays a vital role in Invincible, and this wallpaper celebrates that. We have the stern, watchful face of Nolan Grayson (Omni-Man), along with the hero Mark Grayson (Invincible), taking center stage. Flanking him are his mother, Debbie Grayson, and his brother, Oliver Grayson. Lastly, there’s also the beautiful Atom Eve.

Download

15. Invincible on the moon

Here’s another Invincible wallpaper that captures a quiet, contemplative moment. Mark Grayson, in his Invincible costume, sits alongside his father, Nolan Grayson (Omni-Man), against the backdrop of a vast, star-filled cosmos. It’s much like an aesthetic galaxy wallpaper that adds a touch of serenity to your screen.

Download

16. Sudden Attack

This image captures a dramatic moment of surprise and impending impact. Mark Grayson, in his Invincible costume, is caught mid-air, seemingly unaware of the powerful figure plummeting towards him from above. It’s perfect for fans who enjoy the unexpected twists and intense action of Invincible.

Download

17. Dual Perspectives

This Invincible iPhone background perfectly captures the series’ central conflict: Mark’s struggle to reconcile his father’s brutal Viltrumite legacy with his own desire to be a hero. It’s a constant visual reminder of the show’s core themes of family, betrayal, and moral ambiguity.

Download

18. Taking Off

This Invincible wallpaper captures Mark Grayson in a powerful and dynamic pose, showcasing his superhuman abilities and heroic spirit. Add it to your screen to be reminded of Invincible’s strength, courage, and unwavering commitment to heroism.

Download

19. Invincible in Space

This Invincible wallpaper captures Mark Grayson soaring through a breathtaking cosmic scene. It’s sure to appeal to you if you like space wallpapers. Or simply if you want an inspiring and visually stunning background that captures the thrill of interstellar travel and the boundless possibilities of the Invincible universe.

Download

20. Invincible logo wallpaper

This typography wallpaper shows the title of the series rendered in bold red letters with a textured, almost distressed effect. The letters have a slight 3D quality, giving them a sense of depth and impact. It’s a great way of showcasing your love for the Invincible universe!

Download

Signing Off

We hope you enjoy these Invincible wallpapers. You might also want to check out our regularly updated wallpaper collections featuring trending themes to enhance the look of your iPhone.

FAQs

Are these Invincible wallpapers free to download?

Yes, all wallpapers on this page are free to download directly to your iPhone.

Are these wallpapers optimized for iPhone screens?

Yes, all wallpapers are in 4K resolution and sized to fit iPhone displays without cropping or quality loss.

Which Invincible characters are featured in these wallpapers?

The collection includes Mark Grayson (Invincible), Omni-Man, Atom Eve, Debbie Grayson, Oliver Grayson, and several unnamed antagonists from the series.

How do I set an Invincible wallpaper on my iPhone?

After downloading, open the Photos app, select the wallpaper, tap the share icon, and choose Use as Wallpaper. You can then set it for your Lock Screen, Home Screen, or both.

title.rendered: How to Block or Unblock Someone on WhatsApp

content.rendered:
Getting unwanted messages on WhatsApp can be frustrating. Whether it’s spam, frequent calls, or people you’d rather not hear from. Whatever the reason, you have full control over who can reach you on WhatsApp. In this guide, you’ll learn exactly how to block or unblock someone on WhatsApp using iPhone, Android, and WhatsApp Web or Desktop.

Table of Contents
  • How to Block Someone on WhatsApp
    • Block on iPhone
    • Block on Android
    • Block on Web/Desktop
  • What Happens After You Block Someone on WhatsApp?
  • How to Unblock Someone on WhatsApp (iPhone, Android, Web)
    • Unblock on iPhone
    • Unblock on Android
    • Unblock on Web/Desktop
  • Final Thoughts

How to Block Someone on WhatsApp

You can block someone directly from a chat or through settings; both options are native to the app and easy to use. Here’s how:

Block on iPhone

From the Chat

  1. Open WhatsApp.
  2. Open the chat of the person you want to block.
  3. Tap their name at the top of the screen.
  4. Scroll down and tap Block Contact.
  5. Tap Block to confirm.

You can also block them directly in the chat list.
Open WhatsApp > long-press Chat Name > tap Block

From Settings

  1. Open WhatsApp.
  2. Tap Settings at the bottom right.
  3. Go to Privacy.
  4. Scroll down and select Contacts. Then tap Blocked.
  5. Tap Add New.
  6. Select the contact you want to block.

This method is helpful if you want to block someone without opening their chat.

Block on Android

On Android, the steps are slightly different but just as simple.

From the Chat

  1. Open WhatsApp and the contact’s chat.
  2. Tap three dots in the top-right corner.
  3. Tap More and select Block.
  4. Tap Block again to confirm.

You can also choose to report the contact if needed.

From Settings

  1. Open WhatsApp.
  2. Tap three dots in the top-right corner.
  3. Select Settings and then tap Privacy.
  4. Tap Contacts and then Blocked Contacts.
  5. Tap the Add icon in the top-right corner and choose the contact.

Block on Web/Desktop

If you’re using WhatsApp on your computer, you can block contacts there too. Follow these steps:

  1. Open WhatsApp Web or the Desktop app.
  2. Open the chat with the person.
  3. Click their name at the top.
  4. Scroll down and click Block.
  5. Confirm your choice.

What Happens After You Block Someone on WhatsApp?

Once you block them, you’ll stop getting their calls and messages immediately. Anything they try to send while blocked won’t show up later, even if you unblock them. Your existing chat history stays on your phone unless you delete it yourself.

Here is what actually changes:

  • Messages they send will show only one gray check mark and won’t be delivered.
  • They cannot call you using WhatsApp voice or video.
  • Your Last Seen and Online status will be hidden.
  • Access to your WhatsApp Status & profile photo updates will be blocked.

Blocking only affects WhatsApp messages and calls. If they have your phone number, they can still contact you via regular calls or SMS unless you block them there too.

How to Unblock Someone on WhatsApp (iPhone, Android, Web)

Unblocking a contact quickly restores their access to your WhatsApp. Here’s how to do it:

Unblock on iPhone

From the Chat

  1. Open the blocked chat.
  2. Tap the contact’s name.
  3. Scroll down and tap Unblock Contact.

From Settings

This method is useful if you do not want to open the chat first.

  1. Open WhatsApp.
  2. Tap Settings and then Privacy.
  3. Tap Blocked.
  4. Swipe left on the contact and tap Unblock.

Unblock on Android

From the Chat

  1. Open the chat.
  2. Tap Unblock at the bottom of the conversation.

From Settings

  1. Open WhatsApp.
  2. Tap three dots at the top right corner and then select Settings.
  3. Go to Privacy, scroll to Contacts, and then tap Blocked Contacts. Same as the Block method.
  4. Now, tap Contact.
  5. Select Unblock.

Unblock on Web/Desktop

From the Chat

  1. Open the chat.
  2. Click the contact’s name.
  3. Select Unblock.

From Settings

  1. Click Settings at the bottom-left of the chat list.
  2. Select Privacy, and then Blocked contacts.
  3. Select the contact and click Unblock.

Final Thoughts

Blocking someone on WhatsApp is quick and easy on iPhone, Android, or desktop. It helps protect your privacy and stop unwanted messages. You can also unblock them at any time to resume the conversation.

FAQs

How do you know if a person has blocked you on WhatsApp?

You cannot get direct confirmation. But if messages show one check mark, profile and status updates are hidden, and calls fail, you’re likely blocked.

Can I still see WhatsApp messages from someone I blocked?

Yes. You can still see the old chat history that was already on your phone before blocking them. However, you won’t get any new messages while they are blocked.

When you block someone from WhatsApp, what do they see?

They can still see the chat history you shared before blocking. Their messages to you will remain undelivered.

Will Someone Know If You Block or Unblock Them?

WhatsApp does not notify users when they are blocked or unblocked. Once unblocked, they can send messages and see your profile information, depending on your privacy settings.

  • How to Silence Unknown Callers in WhatsApp on iPhone
  • How to Hide WhatsApp Message Preview on iPhone

mainEntity.name: How do you know if a person has blocked you on WhatsApp?

mainEntity.name: Can I still see WhatsApp messages from someone I blocked?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can still see the old chat history that was already on your phone before blocking them. However, you won’t get any new messages while they are blocked.

title.rendered: Apple Maps Adds Detailed 3D Formula 1 Track Guides Ahead of 2026 Season

content.rendered:
Apple has updated Apple Maps with detailed 3D representations of Formula 1 circuits ahead of the 2026 season, starting with the Formula 1 Qatar Airways Australian Grand Prix at Albert Park in Melbourne. The update arrives weeks before Apple begins its first season holding exclusive US streaming rights for Formula 1 on Apple TV.

The new experience is part of a “2026 Formula 1 Tracks Around the World” guide available within Apple Maps. The guide includes all 24 Grand Prix circuits on the 2026 calendar and will receive additional 3D enhancements throughout the season.

Albert Park Receives Expanded 3D Race Detail

At Albert Park, Apple Maps now displays a detailed circuit layout that includes all 14 turns, realistic kerbs, labeled grandstands, and footbridges. The map also features a 3D model of the Pit Building and other race-specific structures.

Users attending the race in person can view pop-up markers for entrance gates, restrooms, water stations, first aid locations, and merchandise stands. Apple Maps also provides walking directions to specific grandstands inside the venue.

Beyond the track itself, Apple has added 3D renderings of surrounding landmarks, including Lakeside Stadium, the Melbourne Sports & Aquatic Centre, AAMI Park, Marvel Stadium, Rod Laver Arena, the Royal Exhibition Building, the Shrine of Remembrance, Eureka Tower, Luna Park, and St. Paul’s Cathedral.

More Tracks Gaining Custom 3D Models

The 2026 Formula 1 guide showcases circuits across the full calendar, with several already upgraded with new 3D objects. These include the Miami International Autodrome, Circuit Gilles Villeneuve in Montreal, Circuit de Monaco, Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya, the Red Bull Ring, and Silverstone.

At upgraded venues, Apple has added detailed paddock areas, stands, and surrounding structures rendered in the same style as its custom city landmarks. Some circuits have not yet received the enhanced models and currently appear with simplified or flat representations.

Apple says additional race locations will gain detailed elements as the season progresses.

F1 Integration Across Apple’s Services

The Apple Maps update is part of a broader Formula 1 integration across Apple’s ecosystem. Within the Apple TV Formula 1 channel, users can access the track guide alongside related content, including F1 programming, curated news coverage, podcast categories, App Store collections, and Fitness+ features.

Beginning with the 2026 season, Apple TV subscribers in the United States can stream all Formula 1 races at no additional charge. The Maps enhancements position each Grand Prix as both a navigational tool for attendees and a promotional surface within Apple’s services ecosystem.

title.rendered: How to Mirror Your Apple Watch on Your iPhone: A Simple Guide

content.rendered:
If you find the buttons on your Apple Watch too small or want a bigger screen to control it, Apple Watch Mirroring can help. Introduced in iOS 16, this feature lets you control your Apple Watch from your iPhone, providing a larger, easier-to-see display. Here’s a simple, quick guide to explain what it is, how to set it up, and how to use it.

Table of Contents
  • What Does Apple Watch Mirroring Do?
  • Requirements for Apple Watch Mirroring
  • Turn On or Off Apple Watch Mirroring on Your iPhone
  • Enable Apple Watch Mirroring Shortcut on iPhone
  • How to Control Your Apple Watch with Your iPhone
  • Tips for a Better Mirroring Experience
  • Fix Common Apple Watch Mirroring Issues
  • Wrapping Up

What Does Apple Watch Mirroring Do?

With Apple Watch Mirroring, you can use your watch on your iPhone’s larger screen to view and control it directly from your phone. It uses AirPlay to cast your watch screen, and every gesture you make on the iPhone is mirrored on the watch. This makes navigating menus, changing settings, or using apps much simpler.

Though it was designed for accessibility, it is useful for everyday tasks, especially when you need to make quick adjustments or when the watch’s buttons or screen are not working well.

Requirements for Apple Watch Mirroring

Before we begin, make sure you have everything you need for the feature to work properly.

  • Your Apple Watch must be running watchOS 9 or later.
  • Your iPhone must be running on iOS 16 or later.
  • Both devices should be paired and connected via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.
  • The feature works only on Apple Watch Series 6 or later and Apple Watch SE (2nd Gen).

Turn On or Off Apple Watch Mirroring on Your iPhone

Turning on mirroring takes less than a minute. Here’s how to do it:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Accessibility.
  3. Under Physical and Motor, tap Apple Watch Mirroring.
  4. Turn on the Apple Watch Mirroring toggle.

Once enabled, your Apple Watch screen will appear on your iPhone. It may take a few seconds to connect. For me, it took almost 30 seconds.

Enable Apple Watch Mirroring Shortcut on iPhone

If you plan to use this feature often, add it to the Accessibility Shortcut on your iPhone so you can turn it on quickly by triple-clicking the Side button. Here’s how to add it:

  1. Go to Settings, tap Accessibility.
  2. Scroll down to Accessibility Shortcut under General.
  3. Check Apple Watch Mirroring from the list.

That’s it. You can now start mirroring your watch by triple-clicking the side button.

How to Control Your Apple Watch with Your iPhone

Once mirroring is active, you will see the complete replica of your watch interface on your screen. Now, let’s learn to control and access your watch on iPhone.

  • Tap the Digital Crown icon on your iPhone to open apps or go to the Home Screen.
  • Tap the Side button icon to open the Control Center or hold for emergency controls.
  • Tap the Action button icon to open the Workout app directly (only on Apple Watch Ultra models).
  • Tap and hold the Digital Crown to invoke Siri.
  • Swipe up or down to scroll, and swipe left or right to switch screens.
  • Open any app from the App Library, and it will instantly mirror on your Apple Watch.

Moreover, you can open apps, respond to messages, adjust settings, and even enter your passcode directly from the iPhone screen. The touch controls feel natural because they work the same way as on the watch.

Tips for a Better Mirroring Experience

A few quick settings can make the experience smoother.

  • Enable “Always On” in the Watch app under Display & Brightness to keep the watch screen awake.
  • Increase your iPhone’s Auto-Lock time to prevent mirroring from disconnecting.
  • Keep your iPhone and Apple Watch close to maintain a stable connection.
  • Expect some delays because the feature uses AirPlay.
  • Close unnecessary apps on your iPhone to prevent lagging.

Fix Common Apple Watch Mirroring Issues

If mirroring is not working properly, here are some common fixes.

Start with the basics: make sure Bluetooth and Wi-Fi are on, both devices use the same Apple ID, and they’re properly paired. If the screen still doesn’t appear, turn the feature off and back on.

Still not working? Try these steps:

  • Restart your iPhone and Apple Watch.
  • Update both devices to the latest software.
  • Unpair and pair your Apple Watch again if the issue continues.

Most connection issues are solved by a simple restart or software update. If nothing helps, contacting Apple Support is your best next step.

Wrapping Up

Apple Watch Mirroring is a practical feature that makes your watch easier to control, especially for individuals with physical and motor disabilities. It is simple to set up and takes only a few steps to activate. Once you try it, you may find yourself using it more often than expected.

FAQs

Why doesn’t my Apple Watch mirror my iPhone?

Your devices may not meet the software or model requirements. You should also check Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and pairing status.

Can you mirror an Apple Watch to an iPad or a Mac?

No. Apple Watch Mirroring works only with a paired iPhone.

Does mirroring drain battery faster?

Yes. Both devices use more power during mirroring.

Is the feature available on older Apple Watches?

No. It works only on Apple Watch Series 6 or later.

Is Apple Watch Mirroring safe and private?

Yes. Mirroring runs through your local network and stays linked to your Apple ID, so your information remains private.

title.rendered: Best Snapchat Filters and Lenses to Make Your Snaps Stand Out

content.rendered:
While Snapchat is well known among Gen Z users for its disappearing chats and screenshot notification feature, the regular addition of new filters and lenses truly sets it apart. Snapchat filters and lenses help you enhance the quality of snaps and stories by making them more attractive and compelling. However, not all the filters and lenses are worth your time; some are just poorly made duplicates, and some don’t have much appeal.

To help you save your precious time, I have compiled this list of the best filters and lenses on Snapchat to make your snaps and stories pop.

Table of Contents
  • Best Snapchat Filters for Selfies
    • 1. Cartoon 3D Style
    • 2. Vibes Glasses
    • 3. Devil lens
  • Best Snapchat filters for photography
    • 1. Black & White
    • 2. Moon Rise
    • 3. Date and Time
    • 4. Dreams
  • Best Snapchat filters for girls
    • 1. Violet Light
    • 2. Golden Hour
    • 3. Dark Coquette
  • Best Snapchat Filters for Boys
    • 1. Fire Frame
    • 2. latenight
    • 3. Handsome
  • How to Unlock Hidden Snapchat Filters and Lenses
  • Happy Snapping…

Best Snapchat Filters for Selfies

Bored of the same old filters that just add brightness? Try these Snapchat filters with fun special effects to take your selfie game to the next level!

1. Cartoon 3D Style

Transforming you into a real-life cartoon character, this Snapchat lens brings out the child in you. The lens gives you comprehensive, expressive eyes and a lively look reminiscent of Disney or Pixar characters. It’s a fun filter you can use while sharing snaps with your family or to have fun with your kids.

2. Vibes Glasses

This Snapchat lens adds a chill vibe to your selfie game by displaying oversized, black glasses with words like “Vibes” across them over your face. The filter also tones down the color temperature in your snaps, showcasing a relaxed, fun mood.

3. Devil lens

Bring out the devil in you. As the name suggests, this Snapchat lens transforms you into a devil (a cute one, though) by adding florescent, red-bordered devil horns to your head, removing the remaining colors from the snap. The filter turns everything black and white except the devil horns in the frame. It’s a perfect filter for those looking for playful, edgy snaps or celebrating Halloween in style.

Best Snapchat filters for photography

Snapchat offers a variety of filters perfect for photography, enhancing everything from lighting to color tones. Use these Snapchat filters to display your creativity and stand out in your shots!

1. Black & White

If you are someone who loves to add a classic and dramatic look to your snaps and stories, you can’t go wrong with the evergreen Black & White Snapchat filter. It removes all color from your snap, focusing on light and shadows. The filter makes your portrait and scenic snaps more artistic with a pinch of sophistication.

2. Moon Rise

The Moon Rise filter casts soft, blue tones across your snaps and stories, giving them a calming, moonlit effect. It’s a great choice for evening, indoor shots, or capturing a peaceful nighttime atmosphere.

3. Date and Time

Along with the punchy colors, this Snapchat filter stamps the exact date and time onto your snaps. The date and time stamping are ideal for marking milestones, travels, or fun friends and family gatherings, making it perfect for capturing memorable moments.

4. Dreams

Enhances your snaps with a warm, cinematic color grade that softens highlights and subtly deepens shadows, creating a balanced, aesthetic visual look. The filter enriches colors, improves texture clarity, and adds gentle depth without making the image appear overly edited. It focuses on enhancing overall scenery and surroundings, giving photos and videos a calm, cozy atmosphere that feels polished and visually appealing across different lighting conditions and environments.

Best Snapchat filters for girls

Girls will love using these Snapchat filters to enhance their selfies with beauty touches, playful effects, and creative transformations. Take a look at how each filter adds a unique touch to your photos by trying them out!

1. Violet Light

Want to add a mystical or dreamy vibe to your snaps? If so, the Violet Light Snapchat filter is perfect for you. The filter enriches your selfies by casting a soft, purple glow over your snap, which creates a calming, surreal atmosphere.

2. Golden Hour

The Golden Hour Snapchat Filter replicates the warm and golden glow of sunset by adjusting the lighting and colors to make your snaps look bathed in a soft, golden hue. Ideal for selfies and landscape photography, this filter can make your snaps and story look magical.

3. Dark Coquette

The Dark Coquette Filter and lens combine elegance with edginess, adding dark, romantic makeup and a mysterious, moody vibe to your snaps. Along with the dark, romantic makeup, the Snapchat lens also displays black coquettes on your cheeks and smoothens your skin, setting up the perfect girly look.

Best Snapchat Filters for Boys

Snapchat provides a variety of fun filters that can add personality and flair to your photos. For boys who want to enhance their snaps, some filters are particularly noteworthy. Try different filters to find the one that best matches your style!

1. Fire Frame

As the name suggests, this Snapchat lens adds a flame frame around your snaps and raises the intensity of your snaps. And not just the frame, it also adds flames to your AI-generated sunglasses, making you look effortlessly cool. Use this Snapchat lens to add some heat to your selfie game.

2. latenight

The late-night Snapchat filter adds a cool, dark tone that accentuates shadows and gives your snaps a moody, atmospheric feel. All this makes this filter perfect for guys who love to capture cityscapes in a cozy nighttime setting.

3. Handsome

Designed for male selfies, this filter enhances facial structure for a sharper, more defined appearance. It subtly reshapes the jawline, enhances eye intensity, smooths skin texture, and refines facial symmetry, giving snaps a stylized yet realistic look that feels polished rather than artificial.

How to Unlock Hidden Snapchat Filters and Lenses

While you can simply right-swipe through the available filters and lenses to try new ones, you might not find the one you are looking for. In that case, you must unlock the hidden lens and add it to your favorites for future needs.

Here’s how to do it:

  1. Open the Snapchat app on your iPhone, and make sure you are on the default home view.
  2. Here, tap the Magnifying Glass (search button) icon in the bottom-right corner to access the Snapchat lens and filter store.
  3. Next, search for the lens or filter you are looking for.
  4. Now, locate and select the intended lens or filter from the available search results.
  5. Tap the Capture button to create a new snap and share it with your friends.
  6. Alternatively, tap the Favourite button at the bottom center to add the filter to your favorite lens and filter list.

Happy Snapping…

Snapchat filters and lenses let you add a touch of personality to your snaps and stories. You can also top one filter over the other once you capture a snap, so always try mixing and matching different filters for unique results.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to Fix Snapchat Login Issues (2026 Guide)

content.rendered:
Social media has become a central part of how younger users communicate, and Snapchat continues to lead the way with its fast-paced, visual style of interaction. Millions of people open the app daily to send snaps, maintain streaks, and stay connected with friends. So when Snapchat suddenly refuses to log you in, it can feel frustrating and disruptive.

Luckily, most Snapchat login issues are temporary and can be resolved quickly with the right approach.

Keep reading to learn why Snapchat login issues happen and how to regain access to your account.

Table of Contents
  • Why You Can't Log Into Snapchat
  • 1. Check Your Internet Connection First
  • 2. Confirm Your Username and Password
  • 3. Check Snapchat Server Status
  • 4. Restart the App and Your Phone
  • 5. Update the Snapchat App
  • 6. Clear Snapchat Cache (Android Specific)
  • 7. Disable VPN, Proxy, or Private DNS
  • 8. Unlock Your Snapchat Account
  • 9. Verify Your Email or Phone Number
  • 10. Wait After Too Many Login Attempts
  • 11. Contact Snapchat Support
  • Common Snapchat Login Error Messages Explained
  • How to Prevent Snapchat Login Problems in the Future
  • Login Problems Solved…

Why You Can’t Log Into Snapchat

According to Snapchat’s official support documentation, most login failures usually occur due to one of the following reasons:

  • Incorrect login credentials
  • Too many login attempts in a short time
  • Suspicious activity detected on your account
  • Temporary account lock or restriction
  • Network or server issues
  • Outdated or corrupted app data

Besides these, in some cases, global outages can also prevent login entirely.

1. Check Your Internet Connection First

Like any social media platform, Snapchat relies on a stable internet connection to authenticate your account and complete the login process. When your connection is slow, unstable, or temporarily unavailable, the app may fail to communicate with Snapchat’s servers, resulting in login errors or endless loading screens.

To rule out this possibility, check whether the internet is working fine in other apps. If not, switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data, reconnecting to your network, or briefly enabling Airplane Mode can often resolve temporary connectivity issues and restore access to your account.

2. Confirm Your Username and Password

Another common cause of login issues is an incorrect username or password. Even a small typing mistake, an extra space added by autofill, or incorrect capitalization can prevent successful authentication.

Here’s what you can do about this:

  • Carefully re-enter your username and password instead of relying on saved credentials.
  • Make sure Caps Lock is off and confirm you are using the correct username, not your display name. 
  • If you cannot remember your password, use the Forgot Password option to reset it via email or phone verification, then create a new, secure password.

3. Check Snapchat Server Status

Sometimes the issue is not related to your device or account at all. Snapchat servers may temporarily go down for maintenance, updates, or unexpected outages, preventing users worldwide from logging in.

When this happens, you may see generic errors such as “Something went wrong” or repeated login failures even when entering the correct credentials.

Check online outage trackers like Downdetector or search for Snapchat server status updates to confirm. If servers are experiencing downtime, the only solution is to wait until services are restored.

4. Restart the App and Your Phone

If Snapchat’s servers are working properly, the issue is likely related to your device or the app itself. Temporary software glitches or background process conflicts can interfere with Snapchat’s login system, preventing successful authentication.

In most cases, restarting the app and your device refreshes system resources and clears minor bugs that may be affecting performance.

Force-close the Snapchat app completely (not just minimize it), then reopen it and try logging in again. This ensures the app starts a fresh session rather than continuing a faulty one.

If the issue persists, restart your phone to reset system processes, refresh network connections, and eliminate temporary software glitches that could be interfering with authentication.

5. Update the Snapchat App

Just as running an outdated software version can cause compatibility issues on your phone, running an outdated version of Snapchat can lead to compatibility issues with newer server updates. To fix this:

  1. Open the App Store or the Google Play Store.
  2. Search Snapchat.
  3. Tap Update.

Once the update is installed, open the Snapchat app again and try logging in.

6. Clear Snapchat Cache (Android Specific)

Over time, Snapchat stores temporary data to improve performance. When this cached data becomes corrupted, it can prevent the app from completing login requests successfully.

Go to your device settings, open the Snapchat app settings, and clear the cache from the storage section. This removes temporary files without deleting your chats or account data.

Note iPhone users cannot manually clear app cache from system settings. Cache files can only be cleared in Snapchat’s in-app settings, so reinstalling the app is the closest equivalent when login issues occur.

7. Disable VPN, Proxy, or Private DNS

Snapchat uses security systems to detect suspicious login activity. VPNs, proxy servers, or private DNS services can mask your IP address and trigger security blocks, preventing you from signing in.

Temporarily disable any VPN or proxy, then try logging in again using your regular network. Once you successfully log in to your account, you can decide whether to enable these services again.

8. Unlock Your Snapchat Account

Snapchat may temporarily lock accounts when it detects unusual behavior such as multiple failed login attempts, logins from different locations, or the use of unauthorized third-party apps.

To unlock your account:

  1. Visit the Snapchat Accounts Portal and log in to your account.
  2. Follow the unlock or appeal instructions.

9. Verify Your Email or Phone Number

If you have two-factor authentication enabled on Snapchat, login attempts require an additional verification code in addition to your password. Problems accessing this verification code can prevent you from signing in, even when your login credentials are correct.

It might be that you changed your phone number, switched devices, lost access to your authenticator app, or cannot receive SMS verification codes. In such cases, Snapchat cannot complete the authentication process and blocks the login attempt for security reasons.

Here’s what you can do:

  • Make sure your phone has network coverage to receive SMS codes.
  • Check your authenticator app if you use one for verification codes.
  • Use your backup or recovery code if previously saved.
  • Select an alternative verification method when prompted during login.
Note Keeping your recovery codes saved in a secure place can help avoid future login interruptions.

10. Wait After Too Many Login Attempts

Snapchat includes built-in security measures that temporarily restrict access after multiple failed login attempts within a short period. This protection helps prevent unauthorized access but can also lock you out if you repeatedly enter incorrect credentials or try to log in too many times.

When this happens, Snapchat may display errors such as “Too many requests” or temporarily block further login attempts, even if you later enter the correct password. Continuing to retry immediately can extend the restriction period.

The best solution is to stop trying to log in and wait for a while before trying again.

11. Contact Snapchat Support

If none of the fixes above resolve the login issue, the problem may be related to account restrictions, security flags, or verification errors that require manual assistance from Snapchat’s support team.

In such cases, contacting Snapchat Support is the best course of action. The support team can review your account status, verify your identity, and help restore access if your account has been locked, compromised, or incorrectly restricted.

Common Snapchat Login Error Messages Explained

How to Prevent Snapchat Login Problems in the Future

While the fixes listed above can help you regain access to your Snapchat account, following a few best practices can reduce the likelihood of encountering login issues in the future.

  • Enable two-factor authentication
  • Avoid third-party Snapchat apps
  • Keep the app updated
  • Use a stable internet connection
  • Do not spam login attempts
  • Save your credentials in a password manager app

Login Problems Solved…

And that’s it; we hope this guide helped fix the Snapchat login issues. Make sure to work through the fixes in order, starting with connection checks and password verification, then move toward account unlock and support options.

Know any other fixes that helped you resolve Snapchat login issues? Share them in the comments below to help other users facing the same problem.

  • What do Snapchat symbols mean? Every icon and emoji explained

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to Create a Contact Group (List) on iPhone

content.rendered:
Planning a weekend party, organizing a family trip, or need to send a message to multiple people at once? Lists on iPhone make it simple. Starting with iOS 16, Apple renamed Contact Groups to Lists in the Contacts app, allowing you to create a list and message or email everyone at once without using third-party apps. Your lists also sync across all Apple devices through iCloud when Contacts syncing is enabled.

In this guide, you’ll learn how to create a contact group on iPhone, add or remove contacts, manage lists, and send group messages or emails efficiently.

Table of Contents
  • How to Create a Contact Group (List) on iPhone
  • How to Manage Contact Groups (Lists) on iPhone
    • Add Contacts to an Existing List
    • Remove Contacts from a List
    • Delete a Contact Group (List)
  • How to Send a Group Message on iPhone
    • Method 1: Message All (iOS 17 and Later)
    • Method 2: Create a New Message Manually
  • How to Send a Group Email on iPhone
  • Wrapping Up

How to Create a Contact Group (List) on iPhone

Follow these steps to create a new list directly on your iPhone:

  1. Open the Phone app and tap Contacts.
  2. Tap on the (<) left-angle-bracket icon in the upper‑left corner. This will show all your existing lists.
  3. Tap Add List in the top‑right corner.
  4. Enter the name of your list. Write something memorable, such as Family, Work, or Weekend Team, then tap on the Check icon or Done button.
  5. Add Contacts to Your List:
    • Open your newly created List.
    • Tap Add Contacts in the center of the screen.
    • Select the contacts you want to include.
    • Tap Done or Check icon to add to your List.

That’s it. Your contact group is ready.

How to Manage Contact Groups (Lists) on iPhone

Once you’ve created a list, you can easily update or organize it.

Add Contacts to an Existing List

If you forgot to include someone or want to add new members:

  1. Open Contacts → Lists.
  2. Select the List.
  3. Tap Add (+) on the top-right corner.
  4. Choose contacts → tap Done.

Alternative method: Open any contact card → Scroll down and tap Add to List → Select the desired list.

Remove Contacts from a List

Removing someone from a list does not delete them from your iPhone.

  1. Go to Contacts → Lists.
  2. Select the list.
  3. Swipe left on the contact.
  4. Tap Remove.

Delete a Contact Group (List)

If you no longer need a list:

  1. Open Contacts → Lists.
  2. Tap Edit in the top-left corner.
  3. Tap the red delete icon next to the list.
  4. Tap the trash icon that appears.
  5. Confirm deletion.

This removes the list only. Your contacts remain saved on your device.

How to Send a Group Message on iPhone

After creating a list, you can quickly send a message to everyone in it.

Method 1: Message All (iOS 17 and Later)

  1. Go to Contacts → Lists.
  2. Long-press the list.
  3. Tap Message All to start a group conversation.

Method 2: Create a New Message Manually

  1. Open the Messages app.
  2. Tap New Message (pen icon).
  3. Type the list name or tap + to select contacts manually.
  4. Enter your message and tap Send.

Contacts who do not use iMessage will receive SMS messages (green bubbles).

How to Send a Group Email on iPhone

You can also email everyone in a list instantly.

  1. Go to Contacts → Lists.
  2. Open a list.
  3. Tap the Mail icon in the top-right corner.
  4. Compose your email and tap Send.

This is especially useful for work teams, event invitations, announcements, or customer updates.

Wrapping Up

Now you know how to create, manage, and use contact lists on your iPhone. Lists help you reach multiple people at once without selecting contacts individually each time. It’s a simple feature, but it can save you time and make communication more efficient.

FAQs

Can I create a contact group directly on an iPhone?

Yes. Starting with iOS 16, you can create Lists directly in the Contacts app without using iCloud.com or third-party apps.

Will deleting a list delete the contacts?

No. Deleting a list removes only the group. Your contacts remain saved on your iPhone.

Can I add one contact to multiple groups?

Yes. A contact can belong to multiple lists at the same time.

Can I share a contact list with another iPhone user?

Yes, but only as a static export. The Contacts app does not support real-time shared or collaborative lists.

Read more:

  • How to Hide Contacts on iPhone
  • 5 Ways to Transfer Contacts From Android to iPhone
  • How to Delete Duplicate or Multiple Contacts on iPhone Easily
